280: Bammakom haze. en yirat elohim, da mehemnuta.

Amar ribbi elazar, begin dela sharya shechinta levar meara kaddisha veal da en yirat elohim bammakom hazze, delav atreh hu, vela sharya hacha. veyitzchak ittakkaf beh bimhemnuta, dechama deha shechinta go itteteh sharya.

(Bereshit 26:11) vaytzav avimelech et kol haam lemor hannogea baish hazze uveishto mot yumat. ta chaze, kamma orich lehu kudesha berich hu lerashshiayyay, begin hahu tivu deavad im avahan kammay. deha begin da la shallitu behu yisrael ad levatar darin batrain. yaot avad avimelech, deavad tivu im yitzchak, deamar leh (Bereshit 20:15) hinne artzi lefanecha battov beenecha shev.

Ribbi yehuda amar, chaval alayyhu derashshiayyay, detivuta dilhon lav ihu shelim, ta chaze, efron bekadmita amar, (Bereshit 23:11) adoni shemaeni hassade natatti lach vehameara asher bo lecha netattiha vegomer. ulevatar amar, (Bereshit 23:11) eretz arba meot shekel kesef vegomer, uchetiv (Bereshit 23:16) vayyishkol avraham leefron vegomer, over lassocher. uf hacha, ketiv bekadmita, hinne artzi lefanecha vegomer. ulevatar amar lo, (Bereshit 26:16) lech meimmanu ki atzamta mimmennu meod. amar leh ribbi elazar, da hu tivu deavad immeh, dela nesiv middileh avimelech kelum, veshaddereh bechol mamoneh, ulevatar azal batreh, lemigzar immeh keyaym.

Veamar ribbi elazar, yaot avad yitzchak, deha begin deyada raza dechachmeta, ishtaddal vechafar bera demayin, begin leittakfa bimhemnuta kedka yeut. vechen avraham ishtaddal vechafar bera demaya (vechen yitzchak), yaakov ashkach leh mittakkan, veyativ aleh vechullehu azlu batreh, veishtaddalu begin leittakfa bimhemnuta shelemata kedka yeut.

Vehasheta yisrael ittakkafu beh beraze defikkude orayyta, kegon dechol yoma veyoma ittakkaf bar nash betzitzit deihu mitzva, uvar nash itattaf beh. hachi name bitfille demannach aresheh uvidroeh, deinun raza illaa kedka chaze. begin dekudesha berich hu ishtakkach beh bevar nash deitattar beh bitfilloy veitattaf batztzitzit, vecholla raza dimhemnuta illaa.

Veal da, man dela itattaf behay, vela itattar leittakkafa bitfille bechol yoma. dame leh dela sharya immeh mehemnuta, veitade minneh dechilu demareh, utzeloteh lav tzelota kedka yeut. uvegin kach avahan havu mittakfe go mehemnuta illaa, begin devera illaa deraza dimhemnuta shelemata sharya beh.

(Bereshit 26:22) vayyatek mishsham vayyachpor beer acheret vegomer, ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 58:11) venachacha Adonai tamid vehisbia betzachtzachot nafshecha veatzmotecha yachalitz vegomer. hay kera ukemuha veittemar. aval behay kera, beh ittakkafu mare mehemnuta deavtach lon lealma deate. venachacha Adonai tamid behay alma uvealma deate. venachacha Adonai, kevan deamar venachacha Adonai, ammay tamid. ella da tamid deven haarbayim, deihu ittakkaf techot deroeh deyitzchak, veda hu chulaka lealma deate, menalan middavid dichtiv, (Tehillim 23:3) yancheni bemagele tzedek lemaan shemo.

(Yeshayahu 58:11) vehisbia betzachtzachot nafshecha, da aspaklarya denahara, dechol nishmatin ithannan leistakkala uleitanaga begavav. veatzmotecha yachalitz, hay kera lav risheh sofeh. i nishmateh detzaddika, (salleka leella, nusach acher ithane beidduna da dilella) may veatzmotecha yachalitz. ella ha ukemuha. da techiyyayt hammetim, dezammin kudesha berich hu leachayay metaya uleatkana lon legarmoy devar nash lemeheve kekadmita begufa shelim. venishmata ittosfat nehora go aspaklarya denahara, leitnahara im gufa lekayyma shelim kedka chaze.
Uvegin kach ketiv, vehayita kegan rave. may kegan rave, dela pasku memoy illain, lealam ulealme almin, vehay ginta itshakke minneh, veitravve minneh tadir.
281: Uchemotza mayim, da hahu nahar denagid venafik meeden vela paskin memoy lealmin.

Ta chaze, bera demayyin navin, hay ihu raza illaa bego raza dimhemnuta. bera deit beh motza mayim, veihu bera deitmalleya mehahu motza mayim, veinun teren dargin deinun chad, dechar venukeva kechada kedka yeut.

Veta chaze, hahu motza mayim vehahu bera inun chad, veikre kolla beer. deha hahu mekora deayyil, vela pasik lealmin, uvera itmele. uman deistakkal bevera da, istakkal beraza illaa dimhemnuta, veda hu simana deavahan, demishtaddele lachpor bera demaya go raza illaa, velet leafrasha ben mekora uvera vecholla chad.

(Bereshit 26:22) vayyikra shemah rechovot. ramiz dezamminin benoy lemiflach uleatkana hay bera kedka chaze, beraza dekarbanin veillavvavn. kegavvna da, (Bereshit 2:15) vayyannichehu began eden leavdah uleshamrah, illen karbanin veillavvavn uvegin da, yitpashshetun mabbuoy lechol sitrin kema deat amer, (Mishlei Adonai:16) veyafutzu mayenotecha chutza barchovot palge mayim, uvegin kach vayyikra shemah rechovot.

Ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Mishlei 1:20) chachmot bachutz tarona barchovot titten kolah. hay kera ihu raza illaa. may chachmot, illen chachma illaa vechachmeta zeera deitkelilat bah beillaa vesharya vah.

Bachutz tarona. ta chaze, chachma illaa ihi setima dechol setimin, vela ityeyda velav ihi beitgalleya, kema deat amer, (Iyov 28:13) lo yada enosh erkah vegomer, kad itpashtat leitnahara, itnahara beraza dealma deate, vealma deate itbere minneh. keditnan alma deate itbere beYod, veitkasya hay chachma tamman veinun chad. bezimna deitattad (nusach acher deitattar nusach acher deitavad) kolla beraza dealma deate kidkaamaran, keden hu chedva leitnahara, vecholla bachashay dela ishtema levar lealmin.

Tu baya leitpashsheta, venafik mehay atar esha umaya verucha, kema deittemar (74 amud alef). veitavid chad kala denafka levar veishtema, kema deittemar. keden mittamman ulehallan ihu chutz, deha lego bachashay ihu dela ishtema lealmin, hasheta deishtema raza, ikre chutz, mikkan bae bar nash leatkana baavidteh (pikkude 226 amud alef) uleshoola.

Barchovot, man rechovot, da hahu rekia deveh kol kochavaya denaharin, veihu mabbua dememoy la faskin. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan, veihu rechovot. vetamman titten kolah, illaa vetattaa vecholla chad.

Uvegin da amar shelomo, (Mishlei 24:27) hachen bachutz melachtecha veattedah bassade lach vegomer. hachen bachutz, kema deittemar. dichtiv bachutz tarona, deha mikkan kayyma avida leittakkana umilla leshaala, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:32) ki sheal na leyamim rishonim vegomer, ulemiktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim.

Veattedah bassade lach, da (Bereshit 27:27) sade asher beracho Adonai. uvatar deyinda bar nash raza dechachmeta veyatkin garmeh vah, ma ketiv achar, uvanita vetecha. da nishmata devar nash begufeh, deyittakkan veyitavid gevar shelim. veal da kad chafar yitzchak veavad bera bishlam, lehahu shelam (nusach acher lemeheve shelim) kare leh rechovot, vecholla kedka yeut. zakkain inun tzaddikaya deovadehon legabbe kudesha berich hu lekayyma alma. dichtiv, (Mishlei 2:21) ki yesharim yishkenu aretz, yashkinu aretz. veha ukemuha.

(Bereshit 27:1) vayhi ki zaken yitzchak. amar ribbi shimon ketiv, (Bereshit 1:Adonai) vayyikra elohim laor yom velachoshech kara layla, hay kera ukemuha veittemar. aval ta chaze, kol ovadoy dekudesha berich hu, kullehu inun millin dikshot vecholla beraza illaa. vechol milloy deorayyta, kullehu mille mehemnuta verazin illain kedka yeut.

Veta chaze, la zacha yitzchak keavraham, dela samu enoy vela kahu. aval raza illaa ihu hacha, raza dimhemnuta. kema deittemar, dichtiv vayyikra elohim laor yom, da avraham, deihu nehora dimama. unehora dileh azil venahir veittakkaf betikkuna
282: Uvegin kach, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 24:1) veavraham zaken ba bayyamim, beinun nehorin denaharin. veihu siv, (davar acher 33 venahir keden azil venahir) kema deat amer, (Mishlei 4:18) holech veor ad nechon hayyom, uvegin kach, (Bereshit 1:Adonai) vayyikra elohim laor yom. velachoshech kara layla, da yitzchak deihu choshech, veihu azil lekabbela lelya begavvih, uvegin kach, ihu kad siv, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 27:1) vayhi ki zaken yitzchak vattichhena enav merot. hachi hu vadday, devaa leitchashshecha uleitdabbeka (bachoshech) bedargeh kedka yeut.

Ata ribbi elazar bereh, venashik yedoy. amar leh, shappir, avraham nahir missitra dedarga dileh, yitzchak itchashach missitra dedarga dileh, yaakov ammay, dichtiv, (Bereshit 48:10) veene yisrael kavdu mizzoken. amar leh, hachi hu vadday, kavdu ketiv, velo kahu. mizzoken ketiv, vela mizzikno. ella mizzoken, mizzoken deyitzchak, mehahu sitra kavdu. lo yuchal lirot, leistakkala kedka chaze, aval lo kahu. aval yitzchak kahu vadday mikkol vachol, veitavid choshech, deha keden itachid beh layla, veitkayyaym velachoshech kara layla.

(Bereshit 27:1) vayyikra et esav beno haggadol, deitkellal missitreh dedina kashya (sham) vayyomer hinne na zakanti lo yadati yom moti. ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Tehillim 84:6) ashre adam oz lo vach vegomer, zakkaa bar nash deittakkaf beh bekudesha berich hu veyashve tokfeh beh.

Yachol kachananya mishael vaazarya deittakkafu veamru, (Daniel 3:17) hen itay elahana di anachna falchin yachol leshezavutana miggo attun nura yakidta umin yedacha malka yesheziv. ta chaze, dei la yesheziv vela itkeyyaym alayyhu kudesha berich hu, ishtakkach shemeh dekudesha berich hu, dela yitkaddash beenayyhu decholla kema deamru. ella, kevan deyadu dela amru kedka yeut, ahadaru veamru, (Daniel 3:18) vehen la yedia leheve lach malka vegomer. ben yesheziv, ben la yesheziv, yedia lehve lach malka vegomer. vetaninan demilla oda lehu yechezkel, veshamu vekabbilu minneh, dekudesha berich hu la itkeyyaym alayyhu, begin dikabbelun agra. ucheden ahadaru veamru, vehen la yedia leheve lach malka vegomer.

Ella la yittakkaf bar nash deyema, kudesha berich hu yeshezvinani, o ihu avid li kach vechach, aval yeshavve tukefeh beh bekudesha berich hu disayyea leh, kad ihu ishtaddal beinun pikkudin deorayyta, ulemehach beorach keshot. dechevan deate bar nash leitdakkaa, mesayyin leh vadday, uveda yittakkaf beh bekudesha berich hu, deihu yesayyea leh, veyittakkaf beh, dela yashve tukefeh beochora, uvegin kach oz lo vach. mesillot bilvavam, deyaavid libbeh kedka yeut bela hirhura ochora, ella kehay mesilla deihi mityayshva leaavara bechol atar deitzterich, hachi name.

Davar acher ashre adam oz lo vach, oz, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 29:11) Adonai oz leammo yitten, begin deitzterich leh lebar nash deyitassak beorayyta lishmeh dekudesha berich hu, dechol man deitassak beorayyta vela ishtaddal lishmah, tav leh dela itbere. mesillot bilvavam, may mesillot bilvavam, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 68:5) solu larochev baaravot beyah shemo. da hahi orayyta, deihu ishtaddal bah learama leh lekudesha berich hu ulemebad leh chativa bealma.

Ta chaze, yaakov kol ovadoy havu lishma dekudesha berich hu, uvegin kach kudesha berich hu hava immeh tadir, dela aade minneh shechinta. deha beshata dekara leh yitzchak leesav bereh, yaakov la hava tamman, ushechinta odaat lah lerivka, verivka odaat leh leyaakov.

Ribbi yose amar, ta chaze, i chas veshalom behahu zimna yitbarach esav, la shelot yaakov lealmin. ella meim kudesha berich hu hava, vecholla beatreh ata kedka chaze. ta chaze, (Bereshit 25:28) verivka ohevet et yaakov ketiv, veha ittemar. uvegin kach shadrat begineh deyaakov, (Bereshit 27:6) hinne shamati et avicha medabber el esav achicha lemor.
Veatta beni shema bekoli vegomer. behahu zimna, erev pesach hava, uvae yetzer hara leitbaara, uleshalletaa sihara, raza
283: Dimhemnuta. veal da avdat tere tavshilin.

Ribbi yehuda amar, ramaz hacha dezamminin benoy deyaakov lekarva shene seirim, chad laAdonai, vechad laazazel beyoma dechippure. uvegin kach, karivat shene gedaye izzim, (145 amud bet) chad begin darga dilela, vechad begin lechafyay dargeh deesav dela yishlot aleh deyaakov, veal da sheni gedaye izzim, umittarvayyhu taim yitzchak veachil.

(Bereshit 27:25) vayyave lo yayin vayyesht, vayyave lo yayin, remez ramiz, meatar rachik kariv leh mehahu atar (deesav). ribbi elazar amar, remez mehahu yayin dechol chadu ishtechach beh, begin lechadta leh leyitzchak, devae chedva, kedka bayayn chedva lechadta sitra (delevae) dileh, veal da vayyave lo yayin vayyesht.

(Bereshit 27:15) vattikkach rivka et bigde esav vegomer, illen inun levushin deravavch esav minnimrod, veillen levushe yekar dehavu min adam harishon, veatu leyada denimrod, uvehu hava tzad tzeda nimrod, dichtiv, (Bereshit 10:9) hu haya gibbor tzayid (137 amud bet, Vayikra 64 amud alef) lifne Adonai vegomer, veesav nafak lechakla, veaggach beh kerava benimrod vekatal leh, venasav illen levushin minneh, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 25:29) vayyavo esav min hassade vehu ayef, veukemuha. ketiv hacha vehu ayef, uchetiv hatam (Yirmeyahu 4:31) ki ayfa nafshi lehorgim.

Veesav hava salik lon leinun levushin legabbah derivka, uvehu hava nafik vetzad tzeda, vehahu yoma la natal lon, venafak lechakla veitakkav tamman. vechad hava lavish lon esav, la havu salkin rechin kelal. kevan delavish lon yaakov, keden tavat aveda leatrah, useliku rechin. begin deshufereh deyaakov, shufereh deadam hava. uvegin kach ahadaru behahi shata leatrayyhu, useliku rechin.

Amar ribbi yose, shufereh deyaakov (hava) deihu shufereh deadam ech efshar, veha taninan, tappuach akevo deadam harishon, makkehe galgal chamma. vei tema dechach hava yaakov. amar leh ribbi elazar, vadday hachi hava, bekadmita ad la chav adam harishon, la havu yachlin kol beriyayn leistakkala beshufereh. kevan dechata, ishtanni shufereh venitmaach rumeh veitavid bar mea ammin. veta chaze, shufereh deadam harishon, raza ihu, dimhemnuta illaa talya behahu shufera, uvegin kach, (Tehillim 90:17) vihi noam Adonai elohenu alenu. uchetiv, (Tehillim 27:4) lachazot benoam Adonai, veda hu shufereh deyaakov vadday, vecholla raza illaa ihu.

Vayyarach et reach begadav vayvarachehu. ta chaze, vayyarach et reach habbegadim lo ketiv, ella reach begadav. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 104:2) ote or kassalma note shamayim kayria. davar acher (nusach acher da hu) vayyarach et reach begadav vayvarachehu. dechevan dealbish lon yaakov, seliku rechin behahi shata, vead dela arach (deorach) rechin dilvusheh, la barcheh, deha keden (lo) yada deitchaze hu leitbarcha, dei la itchaze leitbarcha, la seliku kol hanni rechin kaddishin bahadeh, hada hu dichtiv vayyarach et reach begadav vayvarachehu.

(Bereshit 27:27) vayyomer ree reach beni kereach sade asher beracho Adonai. (102 amud bet) vayyomer, milla satim hu. it deamre shechinta havat, veit deamre yitzchak hava. keriach sade asher beracho Adonai, man sade, da sade (249 amud bet) detappuchim. sade deavahan illain (chameydey) semichu leh umetaknin leh.

Veyitten lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim umishmanne haaretz verov dagan vetirosh. amar ribbi abba, hay kera ukemuha, aval (patach rabbi abba veamar) ta chaze, (Tehillim 120:1) shir hammaalot el Adonai batztzarata li karati vayyaaneni. kamma shirin vetushebchan amar david malka kamme kudesha berich hu, vecholla begin leatkana dargeh ulemebad leh shema, kema deat amer, (Shmuel 2 8:13) vayyaas david shem, veshirata da amar (sefer acher 33 leh) kad chama ovada da leyaakov (sefer acher deyaakov).
Ribbi elazar amar, yaakov amar shirata da (deha), beshata deamar leh avoy, (Bereshit 27:21) gesha na vaamushcha beni haatta ze beni esav im lo, keden (davar acher begin) dehava (hava)
284: Yaakov beaku saggi, dedachil deavoy yeda leh veishtemoda kammeh. ma ketiv, (Bereshit 27:23) velo hikkiro ki hayu yadav kide esav achiv seirot vayvarachehu. keden amar, (Tehillim 120:1) el Adonai batztzarata li karati vayyaaneni.

(Sham) Adonai hatztzila nafshi missefat sheker millashon remiya, da hu darga deesav sharya beh, deihu sefat sheker (sefer acher ma hu). sefat sheker, beshata deayyte hahu chivya levavtin al alma, uvechakkimu uvaakimu ayyte levavtin, deitlatya alma.

Ta chaze, beshata deamar yitzchak leesav, (Bereshit 27:3) vetze hassade vetzuda li tzayido, beHei, veukemuha. venafak esav begin deyitbarech miyyitzchak, dekaamar leh, (Bereshit 27:7) vaavarechcha lifne Adonai, deillu amar vaavarechcha vela yattir, yaot. kevan deamar lifne Adonai, behahi shata izdaza karse yekara dekudesha berich hu, amra, uma deyippuk chivya meinun levavtin, veyishtaar yaakov behu.

Behahi shata, izdamman michael veata kammeh deyaakov, ushechinta bahadeh, veyada yitzchak, vechama legan eden bahadeh deyaakov, uvarcheh kammeh. vechad al esav, al bahadeh gehinnom. veal da (Bereshit 27:33) vayyecherad yitzchak charada gedola ad meod, dechashav dela hava esav behahu sitra, patach veamar, (Bereshit 27:33) vaavorachehu gam baruch yihye.

Begin kach, izdamman yaakov bechachmeta uvaakimu deayyte birchan aleh deyaakov deihu kegavvna deadam harishon, veitnetalu mehahu chivya deihu sefat shaker. dechamma shikra amar, vechamma mille deshikra avad, begin leataa uleayytaa levavtin al alma. begin kach, ata yaakov bechachma veate leavuy, begin leayytaa birchan al alma, ulenatla minneh ma demana mealma, umidda lokovel midda hava. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 109:17) vayyeehav kelala vattevoehu velo chafetz bivracha vattirchak mimmennu. aleh ketiv, (Bereshit 3:14) arur atta mikkol habbehema umikkol chayyat hassade. veishtaar beh ledare darin, veata yaakov venatil minneh birchan.

Umin yomoy deadam, izdamman yaakov lenatla mehahu chivya, kol hanne birchan, veishtaar ihu bilvavtin vela nafak minnayyhu. vedavid amar beruach kudesha, (Tehillim 120:3-4) ma yitten lecha uma yosif lach lashon remiyya chitztze gibbor shenunim. ma ichpat leh lehahu chivya visha, deayyte levavtin al alma. kema deamru, nachash noshech umemit, velet leh hanaa minneh.

Lashon remiyya, derame leh leadam uleitteteh, veayyte bisha aleh veal alma. levatar ata yaakov, venatil middileh kol inun birchan. chitztze gibbor shenunim, da esav denatar devavu (nusach acher daagazeym) leyaakov al inun birchan, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 27:41) vayyistom esav et yaakov al habberacha vegomer. (davar acher 33 401 chaze)

Veyitten lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim umishmanne haaretz, ha milleela umittatta bechibbura chada. verov dagan vetirosh, ha ukemuha. aval kedichtiv, (Tehillim 37:25) velo raiti tzaddik neezav vezaro mevakkesh lachem. ta chaze, (sham) naar hayiti vegomer veukemuha, hay kera saro shel olam amaro vechulei. uvegin kach amar verov dagan vetirosh.

Yaavducha ammim veyishtachavu lecha leummim, bezimna deshallit shelomo malka biyrushalam, dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 2 9:24) vechol malche haaretz vegomer meviim ish minchato vegomer. (Bereshit 27) veyishtachavu lecha leummim, bezimna deyete malka meshicha, dichtiv, (Tehillim 72:11) veyishtachavu lo chol melachim. ribbi yehuda amar, kolla bezimna deyete malka meshicha, kedichtiv veyishtachavu lo chol melachim kol goyim yaavduhu.

Hve gevir leachecha, hve, vela amar hye, o tihye. ella da raza illaa dimhemnuta, deillen atvavn innun raze dimhemnuta. Adonai leela, vav beemtzaita, Adonai levatar. uvegin kach amar, heve gevir leachecha, leshalletaa alayyhu uleraddaa lon, bezimna deata david malka. ribbi yose amar, kolla ihu bezimna deyete malka meshicha, deha begin deavru yisrael al pitgame orayyta, keden (Bereshit 27:40) ufarakta ullo meal tzavvarecha.
Veyitten lecha haelohim ribbi yose amar, kol hanne
285: Birchan missitra dechulakeh deyaakov havu umiddileh natal, veillen birchan hava ka bae yitzchak levarcha leh leesav, uvegin kach avad kudesha berich hu, vegaram leh leyaakov lenatla middileh.

Ta chaze, beshata dehahu nachash ayyte levavtin al alma veitlatya ara, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 3:17) uleadam amar ki shamata lekol ishtecha vegomer, arura haadama baavurecha vegomer, dela tehe avda perin veibbin kedka yeut. lokovel da, umishmanne haaretz. (sham) beitztzavon tochalenna, lokovel da mittal hashshamayim. (sham) vekotz vedardar tatzmiach lach, lokovel da, verov dagan vetirosh. (sham) bezeat appecha tochal lechem, lokovel da, (Bereshit 27:28) yaavducha ammim veyishtachavu lecha leummim, deinun yaavdun ara veyiflechun bechakla, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 61:5) uveni nechar ikkarechem vechormechem. vecholla natal yaakov, da lokovel da, umiddileh natal. vekudesha berich hu garim leh leyaakov deyittol hanne birchan, leitdabbeka beatreh vechulakeh, veesav leitdabbeka beatreh vechulakeh.
Amar rabbi chizkiyya, veha chaminan demishmanne haaretz umital hashshamayim, inun birchan natal esav levatar, kema deat amer, hinne mishmanne haaretz yihye moshavecha umital hashshamayim meal.

Amar ribbi shimon, lav hay kehay vela da keda, kamma itparshan dargin. beyaakov ketiv, veyitten lecha haelohim, uveda ketiv yihye. beyaakov ketiv, mittal hashshamayim umishmanne haaretz, beesav ketiv mishmanne haaretz vetal hashshamayim, deha lav da ihu keda.

Vedargin itparshan kamma vechamma. begin divda deyaakov ketiv beh, veyitten lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim, da tal illaa denagid meattik yomin deikre tal hashshamayim, hashshamayim dilela, tal denagid bedarga deshamayim, umittamman lachakal tappuchin kaddishin. umishmanne haaretz, haaretz, (da eretz dilella eretz hachayyim) beesav ketiv umishmanne haaretz, beyaakov mishmanni haaretz da eretz hachayyim dilela, veyarit lah beara dilela uvashshamayim dilela. uleesav beara dehacha letatta, uvashshamayim dehacha letatta. yaakov leela leela. esav letatta letatta.

Tu, yaakov leela vetatta, veesav letatta. veaf al gav dichtiv (Bereshit 27:40) vehaya kaasher tarid ufarakta ullo meal tzavvarecha. mehay dehacha letatta, aval leela la chelum, dichtiv, (tehillim lak) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato. ta chaze, beshata desharu lenatla birchan dilhon, yaakov veesav. yaakov natal chulakeh dilela, veesav natil chulakeh letatta.
Ribbi yose beribbi shimon ben lakuneya amar leribbi elazar, kelum shamata meavicha, ammay la itkayymu birchan devarcheh yitzchak leyaakov, veinun birchan divrich yitzchak leesav itkayymu kullehu.

Amar leh, kol inun birchan mitkayyme, uvirchan ochoranin devarcheh kudesha berich hu leyaakov. aval miyyad, yaakov natal leela, veesav natil letatta. levatar kad yakum malka meshicha, yittol yaakov leela vetatta veyitavid esav mikkolla, vela yehe leh chuleka veachsana veducherana bealma, kema deat amer, (Ovadya 1:18) vehaya bet yaakov esh uvet yosef lehava uvet esav lekash vegomer. begin deyitavid esav mikkolla, veyarit yaakov teren almin, alma den vealma deate.

Uvehay zimna ketiv, (Ovadya 1:21) vealu moshiim behar tziyyon lishpot et har esav vehayta laAdonai hamelucha. hahu malchu deesav, denatal behay alma, yahav leh kudesha berich hu (sefer acher yehe leh lekudesha berich hu) bilchodoy. vechi hasheta lav ihi malchu mikudesha berich hu, ella af al gav deshallit kudesha berich hu leela vetatta, ha yahav lon lishar amin, lechol chad vechad chulak veachsanta behay alma, leishtammasha beh. uvehahi zimna, yittol mikkullehu malchuta, utehe dileh kolla, dichtiv vehayta laAdonai hamelucha, leh bilchodoy, dichtiv, (Zecharya 14:9) vehaya Adonai lemelech al kol haaretz bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad.
(Bereshit 27:30) vayhi ach yatzo yatza yaakov vegomer. ribbi shimon amar, ach yatzo yatza, tere yetziot hallalu lamma. ella
286: Chad dishchinta vechad deyaakov, deha kad al yaakov, shechinta alat immeh, vekamme shechinta itberach. deyitzchak hava amar birchan, ushechinta ode lehu alayyhu. vechad nafak yaakov, shechinta nafkat immeh, hada hu dichtiv ach yatzo yatza yaakov, tere yetziot kechad.

(Bereshit 27:30) veesav achiv ba mitztzedo. min hatztzayid la ketiv, ella mitztzedo, deihu tzeda dileh, dela hava beh beracha, veruach hakkodesh tzavvcha veamra, (Mishlei 23:6) al tilcham et lechem ra ayin.

Vayyaas gam hu matammim vegomer. (Bereshit 27:31) yakum avi, dibbureh hava beazzut, bitkifu rucha, milla delet bah taama, yakum avi. ta chaze, ma ben yaakov leesav, yaakov amar bichsifu deavoy, baanava, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 27:18) vayyavo el aviv vayyomer avi. ma ben hay lehay, ella, dela vaa leizdazea leh, mallil belashon tachanunim, (Bereshit 27:19) kum na sheva veachla mitztzedi. veesav amar, yakum avi, keman dela mallil immeh.

Ta chaze, beshata deal esav, al immeh gehinnom, izdaza yitzchak, vedachil. dichtiv, (Bereshit 27:33) vayyecherad yitzchak charada gedola ad meod. kevan dichtiv vayyecherad yitzchak charada gedola, day. mahu (gedola) ad meod. ela, dela hava dechilu veemata. denafal aleh deyitzchak, rabbata, miyyome deitbere. veafilu behahi shata, deitakad yitzchak al gabbe madbecha vechama (shechinta) sakkina aleh, la izdaza. kehahi shata deal esav, vechama gehinnom deal immeh, keden amar, beterem tavo (sham) vaavarachehu gam baruch yihye, begin (dechamat) dechamit shechinta deode al inun birchan.

Davar acher, yitzchak amar vaavarachehu, nafak kala veamar, gam baruch yihye, baa yitzchak lemelat leh leyaakov, amar leh kudesha berich hu, yitzchak, garmach ana (ant) layyt, deha kevar amart leh, (sham) orarecha arur umevarachecha baruch.
Ta chaze kolla odu al inun birchan, illae vetattae, veafillu ihu chulak adveh deesav, odi alayyhu uvarcheh ihu, veode al inun birchan vesalkeh al resheh leela.

Menalan, dichtiv, (Bereshit lak) vayyomer shalcheni ki ala hashshachar vayyomer lo ashallechacha ki im berachtani. vayyomer shalcheni, begin deatkif beh yaakov. vechi hech yachil bar nash deihu gufa uvisra, leittakfa beh bemalacha deihu ruach mammash, dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:4) ose malachav ruchot meshartav esh lohet.

Ella, mikkan demalache sheliche dekudesha berich hu, kad inun nachatin lehay alma gelimin, veitgelimu umitlabbeshin (101 amud alef) begufa kegavvna dehay alma, begin dehachi itchaze, dela lehashenaa mimminhaga dehahu atar deazil tamman.

Veha ittemar, demoshe kad salik leela, ma ketiv, (Shemot la) vayhi sham im Adonai arbaim yom vearbaim layla lechem lo achal umayim lo shata, begin minhaga, dela lehashenaa mehahu atar deazil letamman, veinun malachin kad nachatu letatta ketiv, (Bereshit 18:8) vehu omed alehem tachat haetz vayyochelu. vechen hacha, hay malacha kad nachat letatta, la itavak immeh deyaakov, ella miggo dehava itlabbash begufa kegavvna dehay alma. veal da itavak yaakov bahadeh kol hahu lelya.

Ta chaze, begin deshaltanuta dehanne, lav ihu ella belelya vadday. uvegin kach, shaltanuta deesav lav ihu ella begaluta, deihu layla. veal da belelya ittakkaf immeh deyaakov, veitavak immeh. vechad ata tzafra, itchalash cheleh, vela yachil, ucheden ittakkaf yaakov, begin deyaakov, shaltanuteh bimama.

Uvegin kach, ketiv, (Yeshayahu 21:11) massa duma elay kore misseir shomer ma millayla shomer ma millel. deha cheden shuletanuteh dideh deesav, deihi seir ballayla ihu, uvegin kach itchalash kad ata tzafra, ucheden (Bereshit 32:27) vayyomer shalcheni ki ala hashshachar.
Vayyomer lo ashallechacha ki im berachtani. ki im
287: Berachtani, ki im tevarcheni mibbae leh, may ki im berachtani. im odet al inun birchan devarchani abba vela tehe mekatrega li beginayyhu, ma ketiv, (Bereshit lak) vayyomer lo yaakov yeamer od shimcha ki im yisrael vegomer, ammay yisrael, amar leh, baal karchin it lan leshammasha lach, deha ant itatterat bechelach leela bedarga illaa, yisrael yihye shemecha vadday.

Ki sarita im elohim, may im elohim, salleka datach dealeh hava amar. ella amar leh, sarita leitchabbera uleizdavvevga im elohim bechibbura, beziuuga deshimsha vesihara, veal da la ketiv al (sefer acher et) elohim, ella im elohim, bechibbura veziuuga chada.

Davar acher, vayyomer, kema deat amer, (Shemot 15:26) vayyomer im shamoa tishma lekol Adonai elohecha, uf hacha, (Bereshit 32:29) vayyomer lo yeamer od shimcha yaakov ki im yisrael, keden itattar yaakov bedargeh, lemeheve kelala deavahan. ma ketiv, (sham) vayvarech oto sham. may vayvarech oto sham, deode leh al kullehu birchan, devarcheh avoy.

Ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Mishlei 16:7) birtzot Adonai darche ish gam oyvav yashlim itto. ta chaze, kamma it leh levar nash, leittakna sheviloy beh bekudesha berich hu, begin lemebad pikkude deorayyta. deha okkemuha, devadday (Shemot 106 amud bet, 162 amud bet) teren malachin shelichan it levar nash milleela leizdavvevga bahadeh, chad limina vechad lismala, veinun sahaden beh bevar nash bechol ma deihu avid, inun mishtakkeche tamman vekarinan lon yetzer tov veyetzer ra.

Ate bar nash leitdakkaa uleishtaddela befikkude deorayyta, hahu yetzer tov deizdavvavg beh, kevar ihu ittakkaf al hahu yetzer hara veishtalim bahadeh veithappich leh leavda. vechad bar nash azil leistaava, hahu yetzer hara ittakkaf veitgabbar al hahu yetzer tov, veha okimna. vadday kad hahu bar nash ate leitdakkaa, kamma tekifu ittakkaf bar nash, kad itgabbera hahu yetzer tov keden (Mishlei 16:7) oyvav yashlim itto, dehahu yetzer hara itkafya kammeh deyetzer tov. veal da amar shelomo, (Mishlei 12:9) tov nikle veeved lo, may veeved lo, da yetzer hara. ucheden kad azil bar nash befikkude orayyta, keden gam oyvav yashlim itto, da yetzer hara, vedata missitroy.

Ta chaze, begin deyaakov, avtach beh bekudesha berich hu, vechol archoy havu lishmeh, al da oyvav yashlim itto. veda (davar acher da) samael, chela vetukefa deesav deashlim immeh deyaakov, uvegin deashlim immeh deyaakov, veode leh al inun birchan, keden ashlim immeh esav, (nusach acher keden ode leh asu dichtiv yesh li rav achi yehe lecha asher lecha, deha ode leh al inun birchan dileh becharba) vead dela ishtelim immeh yaakov legabbe hahu memanna deitpakkad aleh, la ashlim immeh esav, begin kach, bechol atar tukefa diltatta talya betukefa dilela.

Vayyecherad yitzchak charada gedola ad meod vayyomer mi efo. mi efo, may mi efo, mi hu ze mibbae leh. ella mi efo, dekayyma shechinta tamman, kad berich leh yitzchak leyaakov, veal da amar, mi efo. man hu dekaim hacha, veode al inun birchan devarchit leh, vadday (Bereshit 27:33) gam baruch yihye. deha kudesha berich hu istakkam beinun birchan.

Ribbi yehuda amar, begin hahi charada deacharid yaakov leyitzchak avoy, itanash yaakov beonasha deyosef, decharad charada kehay, beshata deamru leh, (Bereshit 37:32) zot matzanu. yitzchak amar mi efo. beefo itanash yaakov, dichtiv, (Bereshit 37:32) efo hem roim, vetamman yosef itavid veitanish yaakov. veaf al gav dekudesha berich hu istakkam al yedoy beinun birchan, ihu itanash beefo, dichtiv efo hem roim. umittamman itavid minneh veitanash kol hahu onasha.

(Bereshit 27:33) vayyecherad yitzchak charada gedola, may gedola, ketiv hacha gedola, uchetiv hatam (Devarim 18:16) veet haesh haggedola hazzot vegomer, deal immeh gehinnom. ad meod. may ad meod. ketiv hacha meod, uchetiv hatam (Bereshit 1:31) vehinne tov meod, da malach hammavt, keden amar mi efo.
288: (Bereshit 27:34) kishmoa esav et divre aviv vegomer. amar ribbi chiyyay, kamma bishin avdu inun dimin devacha veappik esav kamme avoy, begin deyitbarech minneh, begin dehava chashiv milla deavoy yattir. hachi kara shemo yaakov. (davar acher 33 veukemuha) hachi kara shemo, kara shemo hahu dekara leh, appik tzitza deroka begin kelana. hachi nikra shemo la ketiv, ella kara shemo.

(Bereshit 27:36) vayyaakveni ze paamayim. ze. mahu ze, (ella) vayyaakveni paamayim mibbae leh. ella, milla chad have tere zimne, bechorati, (160 amud alef, Shemot 111 amud alef) ahadar leh zimna ochora birchati, ze hu tere zimnin. kegavvna da, (bareasheytemag) ki atta shavnu ze paamayim, milla chad, teren zimnin. chad deha ahadarna leh vela neheve bechissufa kammeh dehahu bar nash. shavnu, boshnu. anan bechissufa minneh, uchevar ahadarna.

Kegavvna da, amar iyyov, (Iyov 13:24) vetachsheveni leoyev lach, ahadar iyyov, oyev. veukemuha dichtiv, (Iyov 9) asher bisara yeshufeni vegomer. amar lefanav, ribbono shel olam, shemma ruach seara avra lefanecha. vehacha bechorati lakach vehinne atta ahadar milla venatil birchati.

(Bereshit 27:37) hen gevir samtiv lach vegomer, ulecha efo ma eese beni. ulecha efo, let keyayma hacha man demistakkam alach. ma eese beni. keden, barcheh behay alma veistakkal bedargeh, veamar (Bereshit 27:40) veal charbecha tichye, deha hachi itchaze lach leoshada damin ulemebad keravin, veal da amar ma eese beni.

Ribbi elazar amar, ulecha efo ma eese, kevan deamar hay, ammay beni. ella amar leh, ulecha efo ma eese, deant bedina uvecharba uvedama chazina lach, uleachicha beorach shelim. ella beni, beni vadday, ana garimna lach, begin deant beni. veal da al charbecha tichye veet achicha taavod. veadayin la itkayyaym, deha la falach leh esav leyaakov. begin deyaakov la vaa leh hasheta, veihu ahadar vekara leh adoni kamma zimne, begin deistakkal lemerachok, vesalik leh lesof yomaya, kidkaamaran.

Ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose havu azle vearcha. ad dehavu azle, chamu leh leribbi yose sava dehava azil batrayyhu. yatvu ad demata legabbayyhu. kevan demata legabbayyhu, amru hasheta archa mittakna kamman, azlu. amar ribbi chiyyay (Tehillim 119:126) et laasot laAdonai. patach ribbi yose veamar, (Mishlei 31:26) piha patcha vechachma vetorat chesed al leshonah. piha patcha vechachma, da keneset yisrael, vetorat chesed al leshonah illen inun yisrael, deinun lishna deorayyta demishtae vah yome velele.

(Mishlei 31:26) piha patcha vechachma da 2 divreshit, veukemuha. vetorat chesed al leshonah da avraham, deveh bara alma, uveh mishtae tadir. 2 satim mehay gisa, ufeticha mehay gisa. setima mehay gisa, kema deat amer, (Shemot 33:23) veraita et achoray. peticha mehay gisa, begin leanhara (nusach acher lahedarea) anpaha legabbe ela, ufeticha mehay gisa, begin lekabbela milleela, veihi akkesaddera lekabbela. uvegin kach kayyma beresha deorayyta veitmalyay levatar, piha patcha vechachma, bechachma vadday, dichtiv bereshit bara elohim, ketargumo. vetorat chesed al leshonah, deha levatar mishtae veamar (Bereshit 1:3) vayyomer elohim yehi or vayhi or. piha patcha vechachma, da Adonai (kadmaa) dishma kaddisha decholla bah, veihi satim vegalleya, kelila deela vetatta, raza deela vetatta.

(Mishlei 31:26) piha patcha vechachma, begin deihi setima dela ityeyda kelal, dichtiv, (Iyov 28:21) veneelma meene chol chay umeof hashshamayim nistara. vechad share leitpashsheta bechachma deitdabbak bah, veihi begavvav, (veihi) afikat kala, deihi torat chesed.
Piha patcha vechachma, da hei batraa deihu (deihi) dibbur, umilla talya bechachma. vetorat chesed al leshona. da kol dekayyma al dibbur leanhaga leh. vetorat chesed, da yaakov,
289: Deihu al leshonah, leanhaga milla uleachada lah, deha let dibbur bela kol, veukemuha.

Patach ribbi chiyyay avatreh veamar, (Mishlei 8:12) ani chachma shachanti arma vedaat mezimmot emtza. ani chachma, da keneset yisrael. shachanti arma, da yaakov deihu chakkim, vedaat mezimmot emtza da yitzchak, dehava leh daat mezimmot levarcha leh leesav. uvegin dechachma ishtattef bahadeh deyaakov deihu arma, vedaat mezimmot emtza, deitbarach yaakov meavoy, vesharu aleh kol inun birchan, veitkayymu beh uvivnoy lealam ulealme almin.

Meinun itkayymu behay alma, vechullehu yitkayymun lezimna demalka meshicha, dichden yehon yisrael goy echad baaretz veam echad lekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 37:22) veasiti otam legoy echad baaretz. veyishletun leela vetatta, dichtiv, (Daniel 7:13) vaaru im anane shemaya kevar enash ate, da malka meshicha, dichtiv, (Daniel 12) uveyomehon di malchayya innun yekim elah shemaya malchu vegomer. veal da baa yaakov, deyistallekun birchoy lehahu zimna deate, vela natal lon lealtar.

Patach ribbi yesa avatreh veamar, veatta al tira avdi yaakov neum Adonai veal techat yisrael vegomer. hay kera ukemuha. aval behahi shata denafak yaakov mikkamme avoy, beinun birchan, istakkal benafsheh. amar, ha illen birchan, baena lesalka lon levatar learichu yomin, vehava dachil umistafe, nafak kala veamar, (Yirmeyahu 46:28) veatta al tira avdi yaakov neum Adonai ki ittecha ani, la eshbok lach behay alma. (Yirmeyahu 46:28) ki hinni moshiacha merachok, lehahu zimna deant salik lon leinun birchan.

(Yirmeyahu 46:27) veet zaracha meeretz shivyam, deaf al gav dehashta natil birchoy esav veyishtabedun bivnach, ana appik lon midoy, ucheden yeshabedun banecha beh. veshav yaakov, leinun birchan, veshav yaakov, da shechinta (nusach acher dehi immeh deyaakov). veshav yaakov vadday. veshakat veshaanan, kema deukemuha. meinun malkevavn, mibbavel mimmaday umiyyavan, umeedom. deinhu havu deishtabedu behu beyisrael. (sham) veen macharid, lealam ulealme almaya.

Azlu, ad dehavu azle, amar ribbi yose, vadday kol ma deavid kudesha berich hu beara, kolla hava beraza dechachmeta, vecholla begin leachazaa chachmeta illaa lehu livne nasha, begin deyilfun mehahu ovada razin dechachmeta, vecholla inun kedka yeut, veovadoy kullehu orche deorayyta, begin deorche deorayyta, inun arche dekudesha berich hu, velet milla zeera delet bah kamma orchin ushevilin, verazin dechachmeta illaa.

Ta chaze, deha ribbi yochanan ben zakkay hava amar telat mea halachot pesukot, beraza dechachmeta illaa, bappasuk (Bereshit 36:39) veshem ishto mehetavel bat matred bat me zahav, vela gale lon, ella leribbi liezer dehava immeh, begin leminda dechamma razin illain inun bechol ovada veovada deihi beorayyta, uvechol milla umilla chachmeta ihi, veorayyta dikshot, begin kach inun millin deorayyta, millin kaddishin inun, leachazaa minah niflaot, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 119:18) gal enay veabbita niflaot mittoratecha.

Ta chaze, beshata deakim hahu chivya leadam uleitteteh, deakriv leitteta veattil bah zuhama, veitpatta beh adam keden istaav alma veitlatya ara begineh, vegarim mota lechol alma, vekayyma alma leitpara minneh. ad deata ilana dechayye, vechafe (vechipper) al adam, vechafyay leh lehahu nachash dela yishlot lealmin al zara deyaakov.

Deha bezimna deakrivu yisrael sair, hava itkafya hahu nachash veithappach leavda, (144 amud bet) kema deittemar. veal da akriv yaakov leavoy teren seirin. chad, leakkefya leesav deihu sair. vechad, begin darga dehava tale beh esav veitdabbak beh (142 amud bet) veittemar.
Uvegin kach kayyma alma, ad detete itteta kegavvna dechavva, uvar nash kegavvna deadam, veyaakimu veyachkimu
290: Leh lehahu chivya bisha vehahu derachiv aleh vecholla ittemar.

Patach veamar, (Bereshit 25:27) vayhi eshav ish yodea tzayid ish sade, veha ittemar veyaakov ish tam yshev ohalim. ish tam, gevar shelim, ketargumo. yshev ohalim, ammay ihu tam, begin deihu yshev ohalim, deachid (139 amud bet) litren sitrin, leavraham uleyitzchak. veal da, yaakov besitra deyitzchak ata legabbe deesav, kema deittemar. dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 25) im chasid titchassad veim ikkesh tittappal. vechad ata im birchan, besiyyua dilela ka ata, besiyyua deavraham veyitzchak, uvegin kach bechachmeta hava, kema deittemar.

Ta chaze, kad yaakov itar legabbe samael, darga deesav, vekabbil aleh leyaakov, veyaakov natzach leh bechamma sitrin, natzach lechivya bechachmeta uvaakimu, vela itnatzach, bar besair. veaf al gav decholla chad, natzach kemo chen lesomol benitzchona ochora, venatzcheh, hada hu dichtiv (Bereshit lak) vayavek ish immo ad alot hashshachar. vayyar ki lo yachol lo.

Ta chaze, zechuteh deyaakov kamma hava, deihu ata uvaa leaavara leh mealma. vehahu lelya, havat lelya deitbere beh sihara, veyaakov ishtaar bilchodoy. dela hava immeh ochora, ditnan la yippuk bar nash yechiday belelya, vekol shekken (169 amud bet) belelya deitberiu beh nehorin, deha sihara ihi chasra, dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:14) yehi meorot chaser. vehahu lelya, ishtaar bilchodoy, begin dechad sihara (114 amud bet) chasra, chivya visha ittakkaf veshalta, ucheden ata samael, vekatrig leh, uvaa leovada leh mealma.

Veyaakov hava takkif bechol sitrin, besitra deyitzchak uvesitra deavraham, deinun havu takkifu deyaakov. ata limina chama leavraham takkif vitkifu deyoma, besitra dimina dechesed. ata lismala, chama leyitzchak takkif bedina kashya. ata leguppa, chama leyaakov, takkif mitteren sitrin illen desacharan leh, chad mikkan, vechad mikkan. keden, (Bereshit 32:26) vayyar ki lo yachol lo vayyigga bechaf yerecho, deihu atar levar miggufa, veihu chad ammuda degufa, keden vatteka kaf yerech yaakov beheavko immo vegomer.

Kevan deitar tzafra veavar lelya, ittakkaf yaakov, veitchallash cheleh disomol, keden amar shalcheni, demata zimna lomar shirata detzafra. uvae lemezal, veode leh al inun birchan, veosif leh birchata ochora, dichtiv (Bereshit 32:30) vayvarech oto sham.

Ta chaze, kamma birchan itbarech yaakov, chad deavoy, behahu akimu, veravavch kol inun birchan. vechad dishchinta devarich leh kudesha berich hu, kad hava ate millavan, dichtiv, (Bereshit la) vayvarech elohim et yaakov. vechad, devarcheh leh hahu malacha memanna deesav. vechad, beracha ochora, devarcheh leh avuha, kad hava azil lefaddan aram, dichtiv (Bereshit 28:3) veel shadday yevarech otcha vegomer.

Behahu zimna dechama yaakov garmeh bechol hanne birchan, amar, beman birchata deminnayyhu eshtammesh hasheta. amar, bachalasha minnayyhu eshtammesh hasheta, uman ihu, da batrayyta, devarcheh avuha, veaf al gav deihi takkifa, amar, lav ihi takkifa beshaltanuta dehay alma kekadmaa.

Amar yaakov, ettol hasheta da veeshtamash bah, (166 amud bet, 172 amud bet) vaasallek kol inun ochoranin lezimna deitzterich li velivnay batray. ematay, bezimna deyitkanneshun kol ammemaya leovada banay mealma, dichtiv, (Tehillim 118:10-11) kol goyim sevavuni beshem Adonai ki amilam. sabbuni gam sevavuni vegomer. sabbuni chidvorim vegomer. ha hacha telata, legabbe telata deishtaaru. chad, inun birchan kadmay deavuha. teren, inun birchan devarcheh kudesha berich hu. telat, inun birchan devarcheh hahu malacha.

Amar yaakov, lehatam itzterichu, legabbe melachin vechol ammin dechol alma, veasllik lon lehatam. vehasheta legabbe deesav, day li vehay. lemalka, dehavu leh kamma ligyonin takkifin, kamma mare maggiche kerava laagacha keravin, dizminin legabbe melachin takkifin
291: Leagacha behu kerava. adhachi shama al listim chad kappacha, amar, hanne bene tare yehachun tamman. amar leh, mikkol ligyonin dilach, let ant meshadder hatam ella illen. amar, legabbe hahu listim, day beillen. deha kol ligyonotay umare kerava, estallak legabbe inun melachin takkifin, beyoma dikrava, deitzterichu li, lehvu.
Uf hachi yaakov amar legabbe esav, day li hasheta beillen birchan. aval lehahu zimna, deitzterichu levanay legabbe kol malchin veshallitin dechol alma, asallek lon.

Kad yimte hahu zimna, yitarun inun birchan mikkol sitrin, veyitkayyaym alma al kiyyumeh kedka yeut, umehahu yoma ulehala, yekum malchuta da al kol shear malchu ochora, kema deukemuha, dichtiv, (Daniel 2:44) taddik vetasef kol illen malchevata vehi tekum lealmayya. vehayeynu hahi avna, deitgezarat min tura di la vidayin, kema deat amer (Bereshit 49:24) mishsham roe even yisrael, man even da. da keneset yisrael, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 28:22) vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva vegomer.

Rabbi chiyyay amar, mehacha (Yeshayahu 10:21) shear yashuv shear yaakov, illen birchan ochoranin deishtaaru, uchetiv, (Micha Adonai:7) vehaya sheerit yaakov baggoyim bekerev ammim rabbim (illen birchan acharanin ketiv, 2 vehaya sheerit yaakov) baggoyim kullehu, velo veesav bilchodeh, uchetiv vehaya sheerit vegomer, kattal meet Adonai.

Patach rabbi yesa veamar (Malachi 1:6) ben yechabbed av veeved adonav, ben, da esav. dela hava bar nash bealma deyokir leavoy, kema deokir esav leavoy. vehahu yakkiru deokir leh ashlit leh behay alma.

(Sham) veeved adonav, da eliezer eved avraham (87 amud alef) veukemuha, deha bar nash dehava ate lecharan, bechamma utera, vechamma mattenan unevazbezin, ugemallin teinan. dela amar livtuel velavan, deihu rechimoy deavraham, o bar nash ochora deate befiyyusa deavraham, ella ad la yemallel milloy, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 24:34) vayyomer eved avraham anochi, ulevatar adoni adoni, begin deyokir leh leavraham hahu yekara vehahu tivu, orich leh lechamma zimnin.

Kacha esav, hahu yekara deokir leh leavoy, orich leh kol hanne zimnin deyishlot bealma da. veinun dimin, oridu lon leyisrael beshibuda dileh, ad dituvun yisrael lekudesha berich hu, bivchiya uvedimin. dichtiv bivchi yavou vegomer, ucheden ketiv, vealu moshiim behar tziyyon lishpot et har esav vehayta laAdonai hammelucha. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen.

Sitre tora (Kohelet 1:Adonai) vzarach hashemesh uva hashemesh. may ka chama shelomo malka, deshirutta desippera dechachmeta dileh mehacha ihu. ella amar rabbi elazar, shelomo malka hay sippera, okim leh al sheva havalim, vealma kaim alayyhu. veinun ammudin vesamchin, kiyyuma dealma. debgin kacha ikrun havalim, (sefer acher behay hevel denafik mippumeh davar nash veitkeyyaym beh veattearu chavrayyay en haolam mitkayyem ella behevel pihem shel tinokot shel bet rabban. davar achar al shelosha Devarim haolam omed al hattora veal haavoda veal gemilut chasadim. hattora da yaakov haavoda da yitzchak gemilut chasadim da avraham. shelosha Devarim illen inun samchin illain telata min shiva havalim) ma guppa, la ittekyyaym bela hevel, uf hachi alma, la ittekyyaym ella al havalim deamar shelomo malka. veinun sheva, dichtiv, (Kohelet 1:2) havel havalim amar kohelett havel havalim hakkol havel, ha sheva.

Vei tema, i hachi deinun margelan tavan dealma kayyma alayyhu, ha beattar ochora ketiv havalim bishin, veinun setiru dealma, kegon (Kohelet 6:2) ze hevel vocholi ra hu. (kahelated) ze hevel ureutt ruach. ella vday (illen) af al gav dehanne sheva havalim, deinun kaddishin kiyyuma dealma, itt lokovel hanne 7 havalim dechol dinin dealma (minnayyhu) nappekin, uminnayyhu mittepashtin.
292: Veta chaze, shimsha af al gav denahir lechol alma, matlanoy bitren sitrin inun, kema deat amer, (Kohelet 1:6) holech el darom vesovev el tzafon, begin deda yamina veda semala. (uvegin) venagid venafik kol yoma missitra demizrach, veazil lesitra dedarom, (nusach acher dimarav) ulevatar lesitra detzafon, umissitra detzafon lesitra demaarav, ucheden shimsha itkenish, veazil legabbe maarav. nafik mimmizrach dichtiv, (Bereshit 28:10) vayyetze yaakov mibbeer shava. veazil lemaarav dichtiv vayyelech charana.

Ribbi shimon amar, nafik mikkelala deara deyisrael, dichtiv vayyetze yaakov mibbeer shava. veazal lirshu ochora, dichtiv vayyelech charana. (sefer acher nafik mimmizrach, dichtiv vayyetze yaakov mibbeer sheva, da shemitta. denatil meumeka illaa, nehiru denahir, veazel lammaarav, dichtiv vayyelech charana, atar dedina verugeza tamman.

Rabbi yose moke hay kera begaluta, bekadmita hava nachit nehiru meumeka illaa veyaakov hava natil leh, veazel legabbe beer sheva, (Bamidbar 21:18) beer dechafruha sarim, dehava nahir mittamman, veashlim lehahu beer bechol shelimu. uveyome degaluta, natil mehay beer sheva, veazel legabbe charana, dichtiv vayyelech charana, kelomar charon af, umay hi charon appo dekudesha berich hu, darga bisha), ara dirshu ochora.

Amar rabbi chiyyay, kad azil shimsha lemaarav, hay maarav ikre mekomo deshimsha, kurseyay dileh, atar desharya aleh, hada hu dichtiv, (Kohelet 1:Adonai) veel mekomo shoef zoreach hu sham, deazil legabbeh leanhara aleh, venatil kol nehorin vechanish lon legabbeh.

Vehayeynu kema detaninan, kudesha berich hu anach tefille, (sefer acher vetanenan, kudesha berich hu anach tefillin, dichtiv, 0 nishba Adonai bimino uvizroa avezav. vetanenan yemino da tora, dichtiv mimino esh dat lamo. uvizroa avezav illen tefillin. vechullehu natil yaakov, vamekaneysh legabbe meerev, vesihara kanish levatar kol inun nehorin uvutzinin denatil yaakov, deihu yahiv la vaanaher la, vehayeynu detanenan kudesha berich hu anach tefillin) begin denatil kol kitrin illain, uman ninhu, raza deabba illaa, veraza deimma illaa. veinun tefillin shebbarosh, kema detaninan kohen gadol notel barosh. ulevatar denatil abba veimma, natil yamina usemala, veishtakkach (dekudesha berich hu) denatil kolla.
Ribbi elazar amar, tiferet yisrael natil kolla, vechad itmashshecha keneset yisrael leela, natla uf hachi kolla, alma didchura dekudesha berich hu, vechen alma

(Havalim acharanin vecholla kiyyuma degaluta 0 begin deit behane sheva havalim dechol dinin dealma nafke umitpashshete minneh) vikrun havalim ochoranin, lealkaa bene nasha, uleattekana lon deyahachun beorach meshar, veikrun hevel desharya behu choli ra, hevel deihu reutt ruach. veinun kiyyuma (dealma). devginehon bene nasha azlin beorach meshar udechilu mikudesha bericha hu, veal da saggiin inun havalim demittepashte mehanne sheva.

Vesherutta deihu amar, raza deshimsha, deihu hevel, dekiyyem alma, vihu raza leoola bar nash lego mehemnutta ilaa dekudesha bericha hu. uvegin kacha, kol ma dittechott hay darga, lav ihu raza dimhemnutta, veal da ketiv, (Kohelet 2:11) veen yitteron tachatt hashemesh (Kohelet 9:3) bechol asher naasa tachatt hashemesh, deha techott hay la itztzetricha leittedabbaka.
Shimsha besihara, chada inun bela piruda, vesihara af al gav deihu techott shimsha, kolla ihu shimsha, bela piruda. uttechott hay, kolla ihu reutt ruach, veasir leittedabbaka beh.
(Bereshit 28:10) vayyitztzu yaakov, bekitra distimu, miggo sittera setima nappeka, zohar aspaklarya denahara, kelila mitteren gevavnin demittechabberan kechada,

Tosefta bene alma, rechime illaa, huremana devurayyre, kerivu shemau. man chakkima bachu, mare deayynin besucheltanu, lette velinda. beshata deresha chivvavra natil telatt attevavn vegalif lon begilluppa begilluppin, chad 1, chad 10 vechad 50, vitteglif 61, 1 resha illaa decholla, temira dechol temirin. 10 seliku dirutta havi, ishtachlal meresha leela vnachatt letatta, nappak vappik telattin utteren shevilin, ad deitteglippu ben avne yekar demittelahatan. vittekasharu beott 106 deihu dechar vnukeva, teren rechimin. kishura takkippa, behu ishtachlalu, ushema kaddisha behu ittekashar, minnayyhu ishtakkach mezona lecholla (behu), ishtachlalu almin.
Val da itteglif 50 peshuta, kelala ditteren, 50 kepuppa nukeva chada, 10 deihi reutta
293: Denukeva dekudesha berich hu, kema denafke kol nehorin mehay alma, hachi name natil kolla hay alma. deha da kegavvna da, uvegin kach beer sheva da yovla, beer (sheva) da ihi shemitta. (deha da kegavvna da) (kolla lekudesha berich hu) veshimsha (da) la nahir ella miyyovla, (sefer acher veihu natil kol nehorin veyahiv lego shemitta) uvegin kach (bareashet koach) vayyetze yaakov mibbeer shava vayyelech charana, da maarav deihi shemitta.

Ribbi shimon amar, vayyetze yaakov mibbeer shava, da maarav, shenat hashshemitta. vayyelech charana, da shenat arla. begin denafak mershu kaddisha lirshu ochora, dehava arik meachuy, kema deittemar. vechad mata levet el, deihu birshu kaddisha, ma ketiv, (bareashet koach) vayyifga bammakom.

Man makom. ribbi chiyyay amar, da hu mekomo dekaamaran, dichtiv (Kohelet 1:Adonai) veel mekomo shoef (zoreach hu sham). (Bereshit 28:11) vayyalen sham ki va hashshamesh. kema deat amer shoef zoriach hu sham, deha begin leanhara leh kaatya.

(Bereshit 28:11) vayyikkach meavne hammakom. avne hammakom la ketiv, ella meavne hammakom, illen inun avne yekar, margelan tavan, deinun teresar avnin illain, kema dichtiv shetem esre avanim, utechot illen teresar elef (151 amud alef), verivvavn, avne fesilan, vechullehu ikrun avnin, begin kach meavne hammakom, velo avne (sefer acher hammakom) da hu makom dekaamar. (Bereshit 28:11)

Vayyasem meraasotav, meraashotav deman. ella meraashotav dehahu makom. may meraashotav. i tema keman deshavvi techot resheh, la. ella meraashotav, learba (sefer acher reshin) sitrin dealma, telat avnin listar

Kevan deillen itteklilu da beda, ittechazun beh kol gevvnin. argaman. ihu kol chezu dinhorin beh kelilan. ratztzo vashov, inun nehorin la mitteakkevan lemecheme, chibbura chada ittechabberan behahu zohar.

Behay zohar share man deshari. shema ihu lehahu desattim dela yedia kelal. kol yaakov ikre, behay ittechaze mehemnutta decholla. hahu desattim vela yedia kelal, behay sharya Adonai. shelimu dechol sitrin ihu, illaa vetattaa. hacha ishtakkach yaakov shelimu deavahan deachid mikkol sitrin. 212 da, al beriru dishma da ikre, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 41:8) yaakov asher becharticha. teren shemahan ikre, yaakov veyisrael. bekadmitta yaakov, ulevattar yisrael.

Sittera desittera da, kad hava bekadmitta behay soppa demachshava, deihu perusha deorayyta devichtav, vihi tora shebbeal pe. veal da ikre beer, shenneemar (Devarim 1:Adonai) hoil moshe beer ett hattora, beer ihu lehahu deikkere sheva, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 6:38) vayyivnehu sheva shanim. vhayeynu kol gadol.

Veda soppa demachshava, beer shava ihu. veyaakov al behay resha limhemnutta, kevan deittedabbak bimhemnutta da, itztzetricha leh leittebachana, behahu attar deittebchinu avahan dileh dealu bishlam unepaku bishlam.

Adam al vela istammar, veittepatta avatterah, vechata behahi (Hoshea 1:2) eshett zenunim, nachash kadmaa. noach al, velo istammar, veittepatta avatterah, vechata. dichtiv (Bereshit 9:21) vayyesht min hayyayin vayyishkar vayyittegal betocha oholo. avraham al venappak dichtiv, (Bereshit 12:10) vayyired avram mitztzerayma, uchetiv, (Bereshit 13:1) vayyaal avram mimmitztzerayim. yitztzechak al venappak, dichtiv, (Bereshit 26:1) vayyelecha yitztzechak el avimelecha melecha pelishtim gerara, uchetiv, (sham) vyyaal mishsham beer shava.
Yaakov kevan deal bimhemnutta, itztzetricha lemeal

Deappik shevilin, batash ben attevavn, veavad rekia deyaakov ben teren ruchin, vattil beni shayype millule, ad denachatt lehay 50 deihi kepuppa, vchivru lah kechada, tzappon vdarom, levattar ittekasharu kechada. hay 50 kepuppa, beer sheva ikre. veittemalle miyyaakov, leashakaa kol edre ana. val da vyyetztze yaakov mibbeer shava vyyelecha charana. tu, mibbeer shava leela, deha minah nappik, levattar azil leashkaa lecharana, deihu bera diltatta, charon af Adonai, cherv Adonai, dina, be dina, elohim. val da (Tehillim 79:1) elohim bau goyim benachalattecha. (74 kan tosefta)
294: Tzafon, utelat listar maarav, utelat listar darom, utelat listar mizrach, vehahu makom alayyhu, leittakkena behu.

Ucheden (Bereshit 28:11) vayyishkav bammakom hahu. (sefer acher vayyishkav, 12 margelan letatta, vechol inun dargin deinnun al hay makom ha inun 22), kevan deittakan arsa, shachiv beh. man shachiv beh, shimsha. veal da ketiv beyaakov, (Bereshit 48:2) vayyeshev al hammitta, deha le itchaze vela leochora, veal da vayyishkav bammakom hahu. uvegin kach ketiv, (Kohelet 1:Adonai) vezarach hashshemesh uva hashshemesh.

Minchatta lehahi sitra, begin deman deishteziv mittamman, ihu rechima uverira dekudesha bericha hu. may (45) ketiv, (Bereshit 28:10) vayyetztze yaakov mibbeer shava, dimhemnutta. vayyelecha charana, sitra (Hoshea 1) deeshett zenunim, isha menaeppett.

Sittera desitterin, miggo detukepa detihara deyitztzechak (nafak), miggo duredaya dechamra, nappak chad neitztzu ketira, kalil chad dechar venukeva, sumeka kevavrda, mitteparshan lechamma sitrin ushevilin. dechura ikre samael, nukeveh kelila begavvih tadir. kema deihu bistar kedusha, hachi name besitra ochora, dechar venukeva kelilan da beda. nukeva disomol, nachash, ikre shott zenunim, (Bereshit 10) ketz kol basar, ketz hayyamim.

Teren ruchin bishin mittedabbekan kechada, rucha didchura dakkik. rucha denukeva, bechamma orchin ushevilin mitteparsha, umittedabbeka behahu rucho didchura. kashitatt garmah bechamma tachshitin sittera (sefer acher sitra) deraza kezona, merachaka kayymatt beresh orchin ushevilin, lepattaa bene nasha.

Shatya dekariv bahadah, attekippatt beh venashkatt leh, maschatt leh chamra deduredaya, dimroratt petanim. kevan deshatte, aste avatterah, levattar dechamatt leh sate avatterah meorcha dikshot, appeshitatt garmah mikkol inun tikkunin dehavatt mittetakna legabbe dehahu shatya.

Tikkunin dilah, lepattaa livne nasha. saaraha metaknin sumekan kevavrda, anpaha chivvrin vesumekin. beudenaha talyayn shitta tikkunin atuna demitztzerayim, talyayn al kadlaha kol chele deara dekadam. piha mittetakno bippetichu dakkik yae betikkunoha, lishana chadida kecharba, sheian millaha kemishcha. sippevavha yaan sumekin kevavrda, metiku bechol metiku dealma, argevvna levashatt, ittetakkanatt bearbain tikkunin, chaser (Vayikra 114 amud bet) chad.

Shatya (da) sate avatteraha, veshatte mikkassa dechamra veavid bah niuppin vaste avatterah. ma avdatt, shavkatt leh naim bearsa, vesalkatt leela vealshinatt aleh, venatla roshu venachatta. ittear hahu shatya vechashav lechayycha bahadah kekadmitta, vehi aadiatt tikkunaha minah, veittehadderatt gibbar takkif kaim lekovleh, lavish levusha denura melahata, bidchilu takkif meratteta

Ribbi yitzchak hava yativ yoma chad kamme mearta deafikuta, aavar chad bar nash uteren benin immeh. vehava amar chad lechad, da tukefa deshimsha, missitra dedarom ihu. vealma la itkeyyaym ella al ruach, begin deruach ihu kiyyuma shelimu dechol sitrin, veilmale deihu kayyma bishlimu, la yachil alma leitkayyayma.

Amar leh achuha zeera, ilmale yaakov, la itkeyyaym alma. ta chaze, beshata deyichadu benoy yichuda dilela, veamru (Devarim 6:4) shema yisrael Adonai lohenu Adonai echad, da hu shelimu illaa, leityachada beyichuda chad. keden itchabbar yaakov avuhon venatil beteh, veyativ beh bechibbura chada im avahan, leitchabbera dechar venukeva kechada.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, eshtattaf bahadayyhu, veeshma may kaamre. azal bahadayyhu. patach hahu bar nash veamar, (Tehillim 132:8) kuma Adonai limnuchatecha atta vaaron uzzech. kuma Adonai limnuchatecha, keman deamar, yekum malka, leve nayycha demashkeneh.

Teren inun havu deamru kuma Adonai, moshe vedavid. moshe amar, (Bamidbar 10:35) kuma Adonai veyafutzu oyvecha. vedavid amar, kuma Adonai limnuchatecha. may ikka benayyhu. ella moshe keman depakkid leveteh kaamar, moshe pakkid lah, leagacha kerava lokovel sanoy. david zammin leh lenayycha, kema demazmin (leh) lemarih, zammin lemalka ulematronita immeh, hada hu dichtiv, kuma Adonai limnuchatecha atta vaaron uzzecha, begin dela leafrasha lon.
(Tehillim 132:9) kohanecha yilbeshu tzedek vachasidecha yerannenu. mikkan olifna, deman dimzammen lemalka, yeshanne
295: Garma venappesha (aruma). malyay deayynin dachalan, charba shenana bideh (beyadah), tippin meriran talyayn mehahu charba, katil leh lehahu shatya, vearme leh lego gehinnom.

Yaakov nachatt legabbah, veazal leatterah. shenneemar vayyilecha charana, vechama kol tikkun betta, veishteziv minah. dechura dilah samael, avish kammeh, venachatt leagacha beh kerava velo yachil leh, dichtiv, (Bereshit 32:25) vayyeavek ish immo vegomer. keden ishteziv mikkolla, veishtelim bishlimu vistallak bedarga shelim veittekkere yisrael. keden salik bedarga illaa veishtelim becholla, vehava ammuda deemtztzaitta, vealeh ketiv, (Shemot 26) vhabberiach hattichon vegomer.

Mahu (Bereshit lak) vyyigga bechaf yerecho, leh la yachil, aval naga bechaf yerecho, deinhu nadav vaavihu, denappeku min yarcho deaharon, (sefer acher baseybet esh zara. veha ittearu lishmarcha meishsha zara vegomer, vetafsa lon bareshavetahea, ta chaze, ma ketiv beyaakov shelema) (veal yaakov ketiv) vehabberiach hattichon betocha hakkerashim mavriach min hakkatztze el hakkatztze.
Ovadoy begin lemehav chedva lemalka. i archeh demalka dechadan leh bediche hedyote, yesaddar kammeh bediche rofinus ufardashche, vei lav, lav ihu (begin) bedichuta demalka.

Ta chaze, david zammin leh lemalka ulematronita lenayycha, ma avad, shane bediche demalka, begin rofinus. uman ninhu, dichtiv, (Tehillim 132:9) kohanecha yilbeshu tzedek vachasidecha yerannenu.
