Amar ribbi abba, ha ketiv, (Bereshit 28:11) vayyikkach meavni hammakom. vei tema deavna da, illaa (al) kamma (147 amud bet) avnin leatar motaveh, lemishre alayyhu, (nusach acher hay dichtiv) veha ketiv vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva, (nusach acher elyona mibbae leh). begin (nusach acher kevan) deamar (Bereshit 28:22) en ze ki im bet elohim, hacha arim lah kamma illaa, begin detala kol shevacha deze bah, deen ze lekayyayma (letatta) ki im bet elohim. veshappir. veal da asher samti matztzeva ketiv.

Yihye bet elohim lealmin, bet elohim, bet Adonai mibbae leh, kema deat amer, (Ezra 1) lechonen et bet Adonai. vechen (Tehillim 122:1) bet Adonai nelech. ella, atar deve dina ihu mitteren sitrin illain, missitra deyovla, deihu elohim chayyim. umissitra deyitzchak elohim.

Amar ribbi elazar, yovla, af al gav dedinin (nafkin) mitarin minah, vechullehu rachame (vedinin), kol chedu minah nafkin, vehu chedvavta (sefer acher vehu chayravetaa) decholla. ella bet elohim, sitra dedina kashya, i letav, besitra (deyovla) dismala, itar beh rechimuta, kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi. i levish, besitra dismala, itar beh dina kashya, kema deat amer, (Yirmeyahu 1:14) mitztzafon tippatach haraa al kol yoshve haaretz, vadday bet elohim. ribbi shimon amar, bet elohim hayeynu dichtiv, (Tehillim 48:3) kiryat melech rav. it melech setam, veit melech rav, vadday alma illaa, melech rav ihu, veda hu (sham) kiryat melech rav.

Ribbi chiyyay veribbi chizkiyya, havu yatve techot ilane dachakal ono, idmuch ribbi chiyyay, chama leh leeliyyahu, amar maksetitura demar, chakla nahir. amar, hasheta atena leodaa, diyrushala 40 kariv ihu leitcharva, vechol inun kartin dachachimaya. begin diyrushala 40 dina ihu, veal dina kayyma, veal dina itcharav, veha ityehiv reshu lesml alah, veal takkife alma, veatena leodaa lachachimaya dilma yorchun sheni diyrushala 40, deha kol zimna deorayyta ishtakkach bah, hi kayyma. begin deorayyta ilana dechayye dekayyme alah, (tere navesachey inun) kol zimna deorayyta itar letatta ilana dechayye la aade leela, pasak orayyta letatta ilana dechayye istallak (minna) mealma.

Veal da, kol zimna dechachimaya yechodun bah beorayyta, la yachil 131 behu, deha ketiv, (Bereshit 27:22) hakkol kol yaakov vehayyadayim yede esav, da hu orayyta illaa, deikre kol yaakov, beod dehahu kol la pasak, dibbur shalta veyachla, veal da la itzterich orayyta lemifsak. (33 amud alef) veitar
301: Ribbi chiyyay, veazlu veamru milla da lachachimaya.

Amar ribbi yesa, kolla yadin da, vehachi hu, dichtiv, (Tehillim 127:1) im Adonai lo yishmar ir shav shakad shomer, illen innun demishtaddelin beorayyta, karta kaddisha kayyma alayyhu, vela al gavrin takkifin dealma, hayeynu dichtiv im Adonai lo yishmar ir vegomer.

(Bereshit 29:2) vayyar vehinne veer bassade vegomer. rabbi yehuda patach veamar, (Tehillim 3:1) mizmor ledavid bevarcho mippene avshalom beno. hay kera itaru beh chavraya. aval mizmor ledavid, ammay kaamar shira, i begin divreh ihu dekam aleh, kina yattir mibbae leh, deha avish aloy devar nash zeer mikkerivoy, middeochora saggi. ella, mizmor ledavid, amar shira, vehachi vae david, dechashiv dekudesha berich hu salik leh chovoy lehahu alma. kevan dechama, dehacha behay alma bae lemigveh minneh, chade.

Tu, dechama deillae minneh havu bealma, deka barchu, vechullehu bilchodayyhu. yaakov arak, dichtiv, (Hoshea 12:13) vayyivrach yaakov sede aram, vearak bilchodoy. moshe arak, dichtiv, (Shemot 2:15) vayyivrach moshe mippene faro, vearak bilchodoy. vedavid barach, kol inun shuletane ara, vechol inun gibbare ara, vereshehon deyisrael, kullehu arkin immeh vesacharin leh, mimineh umismaleh, lenatra leh mikkol sitrin, kevan dechama shevacha da, amar shirata.

Veamar ribbi yehuda, kullehu iaru behay beer. vedavid ammay la aara beh. ella, david mare devavu, hava lekovleh, (devera) behahu zimna, uvegin kach, la aara beh. leyaakov umoshe, bechedva kabbil lon hay beer, uvaa leitkarva bahadayyhu, veal da kevan dechama lon hay beer seliku maya legabbayyhu, keitteta dechadiat im baalah.

Vei tema ha eliyyahu barach vela aara beh, ammay. ella, eliyyahu letatta min beer hu, vela leela, kema dehavu moshe veyaakov, uvegin kach (47 amud bet), malach ihu, veavid shelichuta, uvegin deyaakov umoshe, leela inun min habbeer, beer chade legabbayyhu, vesalik lekabbela lon, keitteta dechadat legabbe baalah, umekabbela leh.
Vayyar vehinne veer bassade, raza ihu, dechama hay beer leela, da kegavvna da, ketiv, (Bereshit 29:2) shelosha edri tzon rovtzim aleha, i inun

Sitre tora vayyar vehinne beer bassade vehinne sham shelosha edre tzon rovtzim aleh. (Bereshit 29:2) beer, darga daadaven kol haaretz. bassade, chakal tappuchin kaddishin. shelosha edre tzon, telat dargin illain kaddishin, mittakkenan al hahu bera, veinnun, 148 21 visoda dealma. veillen mashchin mayya milleella, vamelayyn lehay bera.

Begin dehahu mekora, yesoda dealma, kad share bego hahu bera, avid pere vanebaya tadir, veitmalleya hahu bera minneh. kevan deitmalya, vadday (Bereshit 29:2) ki min habbeer hahi yashku haadarim, illen inun kol uchelusin umashshiryayn kaddishin, dechullehu shakeyyn vashetaan mehahu bera, vechol chad vechad kema deitchaze leh.
Vehaeven gedola al pi habbeer. da even, dameyneh kashelay bene alma, even negef vetzur michshol, dekayyeyma tadir al pi hay beer, al memreh, lemitba dina dechol alma, dela yechot mezona vetav lealma.

Tosefta (Bereshit 29:2) vayyar vhinne veer basade. ribbi elazar amar, ketiv (Yeshayahu 51:1) shimu elay rodpe tzedek, inun detave raza dimhemnutta, inun deittedabbeku bekishura dimhemnutta, inun deyadin archoy demalka illaa.

Kad seliku teren, vnappeku lokodamutt chad, mekabbelin leh ben teren deroin. tere nachatte letatta, teren inun, chad benayyhu. teren illen mottava dinvie, attar deyanke beh, chad benayyhu, deihu ittechabbar becholla, hu natil kolla.
302: Shelosha, ammay ketiv, (Bereshit 29:2) veneesfu shamma kol haadarim. ella, inun shelosha, darom, mizrach, tzafon. darom mehay sitra, vetzafon mehay sitra, umizrach benayyhu, veillen kayymin al hay beer veachidan leh, umalyayn leh. may tama, begin, (Bereshit 29:2) ki min habbeer hahi yashku haadarim. hayeynu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:11) yashku kol chayto saday.

Veneesfu shamma kol haadarim, hayeynu dichtiv, (Kohelet 1:7) kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam. (Bereshit 29:3) vegalalu et haeven, maavirin minah tekifu dedina kashya, hahu degalid vekarish, (sefer acher mayin daykareyn) dichden ikre even, vela nafke minah mayay levar. vechad inun nachalin atyayn, ittakkaf darom deihu yemina, vela yachla tzafon lemikrash mayin, kehay nahara, kad memoy saggiin, la gelidin vekareshe maya, kenahara dememoy zeirin.

Veal da, kad inun nachalin atyayn, ittakkaf (29 amud bet) darom deihu yemina, umayin ishtaryayn, venagdin veashkeyayn adarayay, kema deamran dichtiv yashku kol chayyto saday. (Bereshit 29:3) veheshivu et haeven al pi habbeer, limkomah, begin dealma itzterich dina dilah, deteheve bedina leochacha beh chayyayvaya.

Ta chaze, yaakov kad hava yativ al bera, vechama maya desalkin legabbeh, yada detamman tizdammen leh itteteh. vechen bemoshe, kad yativ al bera, kevan dechama demaya salkin legabbeh, yada deitteteh izdammenat leh tamman, vehachi hava leh leyaakov, detamman izdammenat leh itteteh, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:9) odenu medabber immam verachel baa im hatztzon, vayhi kaasher raa yaakov et rachel vegomer. moshe, dichtiv, (Shemot 6) vayyavou haroim vaygarshum vegomer, vetamman izdammenat leh tzippora,

Venespu shamma kol haadarim, veneespu shamma haadarim, la ketiv, ella kol haadarim, mashiryayn kaddishin leela, umashiryayn kaddishin letatta, illen beshirin vetushebchan leela, villen bitztzelottin uvauttin letatta, illen veillen miyyad (Bereshit 29:3) vegalalu ett haeven meal pi habbeer, meganderin lah, umaavrin lah min kudesha veistallik min dina. miyyad vehishku ett hatztzon, natlu malache illae leela, venatle yisrael letatta.

Levattar veheshivu ett haeven, al memra, dehay ber, leitteatra (sefer acher laataatadea) kammeh, ulemitteba dina dealma, leittenahaga alma bedina, vehachi itztzetricha deha la yachil alma lemekam ella al dina, lemeheve kolla bikshot uzechu.

Kevan deishtelim yaakov, la itztzetricha lehay even siyyua ochora, ma ketiv (Bereshit 29:10) vayyigash yaakov vaygal ett haeven. vaygal vegalalu, velo ketiv vayyasar vehesiru. llo vegalalu, hayeynu irbuva desatan, dimarbevin leh, dela yachil lekatrega.
Veyaakov bilchodeh, la itztzetricha lesiyyua ochora, llo ihu vilchodeh, deha shelimu deavahatta hava yaakov, dechevan deyachil beh beesav behay alma yachil leela. uvecholla itztzetricha ovada.

Teren almin achsin yaakov, chad alma deittegalleya, vechad alma deittekasseya kegavvna dilhon mammash, mechad nappeku shitt shivtin, umechad nappeku teren shivtin. alma deittekasseya appik shitt sitrin, alma deittegalleya appik teren, veinun teren keruvin dittechottah, vyaakov ben teren almin ishtakkach, bediukeno dillehon mammash, uvegin kacha kol milloy delea havu beittekasseya, uderachel beittegalleya.

Kaim techottayyhu, chakla detappuchin kaddishin ihu. mehay bera mitteshakyayn adaraya, kol inun retichin, kol inun mare gadpin. 3 kayymin reviin (kayymin) al hay bera, hay bera minnayyhu ittemle, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:2) ki min habbeer hahi yashku haadarim vegomer. da 65 ittekre, al da ketiv, (Devarim 3:24) adonay elohim atta hachilotta, uchetiv, (Daniel 7) vhaer panycha al mikdashcha hashamem lemaan adonay. adon kol haaretz, hada hu dichtiv, (Yehoshua 3:11) hinni aron habberitt adon kol haaretz. (ad kan tosefta)
303: Ta chaze hay beer, sheva zimnin ketiv befarshata da, begin deihu remez lesheva. vehachi ikre beer sheva, (uvegin) beer da, idkar sheva zimnin befarshata da. dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:2) vayyar vehinni beer bassade. ki min habbeer hahi. vehaeven gedola al pi habbeer. veneesfu shamma kol haadarim vegomer meal pi habbeer. vehishku et hatztzon veheshivu et haeven al pi habbeer. vegalalu et haeven meal pi habbeer. vaygal et haeven meal pi habbeer. ha shiva. uvevadday dehachi hu.

Bemoshe la ketiv ella zimna chada, dichtiv, (Shemot 2:15) vayyeshev beeretz midyan vayyeshev al habbeer. begin demoshe, (24 amud alef) itparash mikkol vachol mibbeta diltatta, veyaakov la itparash kelal. bemoshe chad, kema dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 6:9) achat hi yonati tammati. achat hi leimmah. uvegin kach moshe mareh deveta hava, veistallak leela, bemoshe ketiv, (Shemot 2:15) vayyeshev al habbeer, beyaakov vayyar vehinne veer bassade, vela ketiv vayyeshev al habbeer.

Davar acher (Bereshit 28:10) vayyetze yaakov mibbeer shava vayyelech charana, ribbi abba patach veamar, (Tehillim 106:3) ashre shomre mishpat (sham) ose tzedaka bechol et. ashre shomre mishpat, zakkain inun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu yahav lon orayyta dikshot leishtaddala vah yemama velele. deha kol man deishtaddal beorayyta, it leh cheru mikkolla, cheru min mota dela yachla leshalletaa aleh, veha ukemuha. begin dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta veitachid bah, itachid beilana dechayye. vei arpe garmeh meilana dechayye, ha ilana demota sharya aloy, veitachid beh. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 24:10) hitrappita beyom tzara tzar kochecha. hitrappita, i arpe yedoy meorayyta.

Beyom tzara tzar kochecha, may tzar kochecha. tzar koach ko, deha ihi tadir limina. unetiru dilah tadir al bar nash kad azil beorchoy deorayyta, ucheden dache leh lara levar dela yikrav legabbeh debar nash, vela yachil lekatrega leh. vechad bar nash aste mearchoy deorayyta veitrappe minnah, keden tzar koach ko, begin dehahu ra, deihu semala shallit aleh devar nash, vedache leh lehay ko levar, ad dedachik leh atar beaku.

Davar acher tzar kochecha, dechad bar nash achid bearche deorayyta, itrachim leela veitrachim letatta, urechima dekudesha berich hu havi, kema deat amer, (Shmuel 2 12:24) vaAdonai ahavo, dehava rechimoy dekudesha berich hu, verachim leh. vechad bar nash aste mearche deorayyta, keden tzar koach ko, tzar dileh, umare devavu ihu legabbeh, veshallit aloy hahu deikre ra. ad dimkatreg beh behay alma, uvealma deate.

Ta chaze, hay ra deihu yetzer hara, shallit al alma bechamma sitrin. vechamma shaltanu it leh bealma, veihu chivya takkifa dechav beh adam, vechashlin beh bene alma, umashche leh alayyhu, ad deappik lon nishmatayyhu.

Veta chaze, kad ihu shallit, shallit al gufa. (338 lecha 172 amud bet) vechevan deal gufa shallit, nishmata nafka minneh, begin degufa istaav, venishmata salka. vela shallit aleh ad denatil reshu. vechamma inun deatyayn missitreh, veshaltin al alma. veha taninan dechol ovadin dealma deitavidu, veshalte behu, veit leh memannan veshammashin, kullehu shammashin beovadin dealma.

Veal da ihu ketz dismala, veha (62 amud bet) ukemuha, deit ketz limina, veit ketz lismala, vehay ketz dismala, ihu ketz kol basar. ketz kol basar ikre, ketz kol rucha la ikre, veraza demilla, da ihu ketz (kol basar) veda ihu ketz, da ketz al (62 amud bet) bisra veda al rucha. begin kach, da penimi veda chitzon. da yemina, veda semala. da kaddisha, veda mesaava. veha ukemuha.

Veta chaze, raza illaa kaddisha dimhemnuta, raza dealma didchura vealma denukeva, vechol kiddusha dekaddishin beh, vechol raze dimhemnuta mehacha nafku. vechol chayyin vechol cheru vechol tavin vechol
304: Nehorin mehacha inun, vechol birchan vetalle nidvan vechol rechimu dirchimuta kolla missitra da, raza dedarom.

Missitra detzafon mitpashte dargin, ad demata letatta kastufa dedahava, besitra mesaava, lichlucha dimsaav, veachid lehay leela veachid lehay letatta, vehacha mizdavvge dechar venukeva kechada, veinun rochev nachash, raza didchar venukeva, veraza da azazel.

Umehacha mitparshin dargin, venafkin kamma sitrin lealma, demitpashtin mehacha, veshaltin al alma, vechullehu sitre mesaava, veravrevin memannan go alma. ta chaze, esav kad nafak lealma, kuleh sumeka kevarda, besaara kegavvna desair, umittamman allufin memannan teresin (sefer acher teresar) deshaltin bealma, veha ukemuha.

Ta chaze, (Tehillim 106:3) ashre shomre mishpat, denatre mehemnuta dekudesha berich hu, begin dekudesha berich hu, ihu mishpat. uvae leh levar nash lenatra dela yiste leorcha ochora, ella dihe natir mishpat, begin dekudesha berich hu ihu mishpat, dechol archoy mishpat.

(Tehillim 106:3) ose tzedaka bechol et, vechi bechol et yachil bar nash lemebad tzedaka. ella, man deyishtaddal beorchoy deorayyta, veavid tzedaka im inun deitzterichu lah, dechol man deavid tzedaka im miskena, asge hahi tzedaka leela vetatta.

Ta chaze, man deishtaddal bitzdaka, hahi tzedaka deavid, salik leela, umata leela lehahu atra deyaakov, deihu reticha illaa. veamshich birchan lehahu atar, mimmabbua dechol mabbuin. umehahi tzedaka, amshich vearbe birchan lechol inun tattae, ulechol retichin ulechol chelin, vechullehu itbarchan veittosfan nehorin, kedka yeut. begin dechullehu ikru et, veda hu dichtiv, ose tzedaka bechol et.
Ta chaze, bezimna dehavu yisrael beara kaddisha, inun havu mashche birchan milleela letatta, vechad nafku yisrael meara kaddisha, alu techot reshu ochora, uvirchan itmenau mealma.

Ta chaze, yaakov hava techot reshu kaddisha, kevan denafak meara, al birshu ochora, vead la al techot reshu ochora, itgeli aleh kudesha berich hu bechelma, vechama kol ma dechama, veazlu immeh malachin kaddishin, ad deyativ al bera. vechevan deyativ al bera, seliku maya legabbeh, vechen hava moshe, demittamman izdammenat leh itteteh. raza demilla, bera la salka, ella kad chama kishra dileh leitchabbera bahadeh.

Veamar ribbi abba, kol hane kerae kashyayn ahadade, bekadmita ketiv, (Bereshit 28:10) vayyetze yaakov mibbeer shava vayyelech charana, velavan becharan hava yativ, ammay natil mittamman, dichtiv (Bereshit 29:1) vayyissa yaakov raglav vayyelech artza bene kedem. uminnalan divcharan hava diyyureh delavan, dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:4-Adonai) vayyomer lahem yaakov achay meayin attem vayyomru mecharan anachnu. vayyomer hayedatem et lavan ben nachor vayyomru yadanu. mashma dediyyureh delavan, becharan hava.

Ella, yaakov amar, ana baina lemeal bishchinta, begin divina leizdavvevga. abba kad itnasiv veshadar leavda, ashkach ena demaya, ucheden izdammenat leh leabba itteta. veha beatar da, la ashkachna la ena vela bera vela mayya, umiyyad vayyissa yaakov raglav vayyelech artza beni kedem, vetamman izdammenat leh bera, kidkaamaran, veizdammenat leh itteteh.
Ribbi elazar amar, charan tamman hava vadday, vehay bera bechakla hava. dei lav hachi, ammay ketiv, (Bereshit 29:12) vattaratz vattagged leaviha, ella begin dehava samich lemata.

Veamar ribbi elazar, yaakov deizdammenat leh al bera itteta, ammay la izdammenat leh lea, deha kayyma leh leyaakov kol inun shivtin. ella lea, la vaa kudesha berich hu lezavvga leh leyaakov beitgalleya, dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:25) vayhi vabboker vehinne hi lea, (mikkelal) deha kodem lachen la itgalleya milla.
Vetu, begin leamshacha ena velibba deyaakov beshappiru derachel, lemebad diyyureh tamman, uveginah
305: Izdavvevgat leh lea, veokimat kol inun shivtin. bamme yada yaakov man hi rachel. ella deinun rayayn amru leh, dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:6) vehinne rachel bitto baa im hatztzon.

Ta chaze ma ketiv, vayyomer (Bereshit 29:18) eevadcha sheva shanim berachel bittecha hakketanna, vechi ma dateh deyaakov dela kaamar eser yarchin o shatta chada, ella sheva shanim ammay. ella yaakov bechachmata avad. begin dela yemrun, divgin tiuveta deshappiru derachel avad, ella begin chachmeta, desihara bat sheva shenin hi. vechullehu sheva shenin illain, sharu aleh deyaakov ad la nasiv lah lerachel lemetav gabbah kedka yeut. deha yaakov natal kullehu bekadmita, ulevatar ata legabbah, begin leishtakkacha ihu shamayim, veihi aretz.

Veraza demilla, vayyihyu beenav keyamim achadim, may keyamim achadim, ella, kullehu sheva shenin shakil lon beenoy, keinun illain. deinun achadin dela mitparshan, (95 amud bet) vechullehu chad, demitkashsheran da beda. beahavato otah, leishtakkacha kegavvna illaa.

Ta chaze, deafillu lavan ramaz leh beinun sheva, vela yada may kaamar, defatach veamar tov, dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:19) tov titti vegomer. amar ribbi abba, hachi hu vadday, palach sheva shenin, leizdavvevga bishmitta. amar ribbi elazar, ta chaze, bechol atar yovla satim dela itgalleya ushemitta itgalleya.

Ta chaze, beshata deyaakov palach sheva shenin kadmain, nafka kala veamar, yaakov, (Tehillim 106:48) min haolam vead haolam ketiv, olam satim dilela yovla mittamman sheruta. deillen deinun setimin, dela itgalleya lon min yovla inun. begin kach istimu miyyaakov, dela yada, dechashav deha min shemitta inun. uvegin deyaavid sheruta meolam dilela, itkasyayn minneh, begin deyovla ihu satim, ulevatar daavaru shene yovla deitkasyay, avad shene shemitta deitgalyayn, (pikkude 256 amud bet) veitattar bitren almin veachid lon.
Ta chaze, lea olidat shit benin uveratta chada. vehachi itchaze, deha shit sitrin kayymin alah veillen shit, uveratta chada, beraza illaa nafka.

Rachel olidat teren tzaddikim. vehachi itchaze, ha shemitta, deven tere tzaddike yatva lealmin, dichtiv, (Tehillim 37:29) tzaddikim yirshu aretz, tzaddik leela vetzaddik letatta. tzaddik leela, minneh nagdan mayin illain. tzaddik letatta, minneh nava nukeva maya legabbe dechura, betiuveta shelim. tzaddik missitra da, vetzaddik missitra da, kema didchura leela yativ ben tere nukeve, hachi name nukeva letatta yatva ben tere tzaddiki.

Veal da, yosef uvinyamin teren tzaddikin ninhu. yosef zacha lemehve tzaddik leela, begin denatar at kayyayma. binyamin ihu tzaddik letatta, leitattera shemitta ben tere tzaddike, yosef hatztzaddik, uvinyamin hatztzaddik.

Vechi binyamin tzaddik hava, in. dechol yomoy la chata behay at kayyayma, veaf al gav dela izdamman leh ovada keyosef. i hachi, ammay ikre tzaddik. ella kol yomoy deyaakov hava beevla deyosef, la shimmesh arseh. vei tema dechad itnetil yosef miyyaakov, ravya hava vela nesiv. veat amart dela shimmesh arseh, ella af al gav deizdavvavg levatar la vaa leshammesha arseh.

Veanan hachi tenan, beshaa deshail yosef levinyamin, amar leh it lach intu. amar leh, in. amar leh it lach benin, amar leh in. vehech ikrun, amar leh al shum achi vechulei (nusach acher amar leh it lecha benin, amar leh zeminin li. veech yitkeron lecha, amar leh al shum achi vegomer) gera venaaman vegomer dichtiv (Bereshit 46:21) uvene vinyamin bela vavecher vegomer, veat amart dela shimmesh. (sefer acher ella behahi shaata).

Amar leh in, deha behahi shata la havu leh. (sefer acher levatar deyatza mibbet haasurin havo leh) vei tema uvene vinyamin bela vavecher. kad alu lemitzrayim, hachi hu vadday, dechol zimna deitabbal yaakov al yosef la shimmesh arseh veolid benin. veamar binyamin, ha yosef achi, at keyayma deabba hava. deha berit siyyuma degufa ihu, kevan deihu itavid, ana ehe natir
306: Vei tema, ha behahu zimna deitavid, la hava tzaddik. detzaddik la hava ad deaara ovada beh. ella, kullehu havu yade miyyaakov. deyaakov hava yeda deatar da yarit yosef, uvegine chach orich belavan kol kach ad deyistayyem gufa, uman hu siyyuma degufa, berit. veal da ketiv, (Bereshit 30:25) vayhi kaasher yalda rachel et yosef vegomer, deha vadday hasheta ishtelim gufa, kevan degufa ishtelim, beina lemezal. uvegine kach binyamin yada venatar orcheh daachuy.

Kevan deata leyosef, veishtakkach. binyamin hadar leveteh, veshimmesh arseh (azle vealu) veolid benin. veal da kudesha berich hu avid leh tzaddik letatta, veyosef tzaddik leela. uvegine kach, rachel teren benin olidat, velea shit benin uveratta.

Veal da, inun sheva shenin kadmae itkasseyayn, dela yada behu yaakov begin dehavu deyovla, veinun dishmitta itgalyayn, uvishmitta deitgalleya palach leyovla deitkasya, dichtiv (Bereshit 29:20) vayyaavod yaakov berachel sheva shanim. sheva shanim setam. berachel palach sheva shenin illain, veitachid behu bitre almin. mikkan olifna, miggo deitgalleya, ate bar nash listimaa.

Vei tema, i hachi dishnin kadmae miyyovla inun, ha beyovla ketiv (Vayikra 25:8) sheva shanim, sheva peamim. sheva shanim shechiche, sheva peamim (lo shechiche) an inun. ella, inun shiva yomin denatar behillula delea ashlimu chushebna, deha kol yoma (sefer acher paam achat usheva achat) (sheva) achat ikre, dichtiv, (Tehillim 119:164) sheva bayyom hillalticha al mishpete tzidkecha. vechol shiva ishtelim beshiva yomin, 7 bechol yoma, deikre paam achat.

Uverachel la hava chen, dela natar 7 yomin, ella sheva shenin defalach levatar. vei tema, i hachi, shenin dishmitta hava leh lemiflach kodem, ulevatar leizdavvevga bishmitta. ella kevan dekabbil aleh lemiflach, keillu palach lon. ata ribbi abba uneshakeh. amar berich rachamana dezachina lehay kera, al hahu atar ketiv (Yeshayahu 42:21) Adonai chafetz lemaan tzidko yagdil tora veyadir.

Tu amar ribbi elazar, ha deittemar lea olidat shit benin uveratta chada, hachi hu vadday, rachel tere benin vadday, beni shefachot arbaa, tikkuna dilhon hech kayyme. ella inun arba (158 amud alef) kesharim deikrun achorayim, dichtiv (Melachim 1 7:25) vechol achorehem bayta.

Deha bidroa yemina telat (241 amud alef) kishrin. aval kishra chad beemtzaita deihu rav veihu achor, deishtaar levar. vechen chad bidroa semala, vechen chad beyarcha yemina, vechen chad beyarcha semala. vechad ittakkan kolla, ishtakkachu kullehu bayta, lekayyma kera dichtiv vechol achorehem bayta.

Kol shear kishshurin, kullehu itchazzeyayn bemeshar veillen nafkin, levar midderoin ulevar miyyarchin, leitchazaa bivni hashshefachot, deaf al gav deinun beminyayna, la chashive kivni rachel velea. uvegine chach nafke levar.
Davar acher illen inun arba, dechol shear kishrin natle beginayyhu, veillen natle lon. amar ribbi abba, hachi hu vadday, (nusach acher amar rabbi abba da lav da) veal da kolla mittakkan kechada.

(Bereshit 29:31) vayyar Adonai ki senua lea vegomer. rabbi elazar patach, moshivi akeret habbayit (Tehillim 113:9) em habbanim semecha haleluya. moshivi akeret habbayit, da rachel deihi ikra deveta. em habbanim semecha, da lea.

Davar acher, moshivi akeret habbayit da shemitta, deihi ikkara, dehay alma, aleh itdabbar. em habbanim semecha, da yovla. dechol chedu vechol chedva dechullehu almin beh talyayn. vehay kera, kelala decholla hu. begin dehay kalil kolla, beraza kaddisha, veal da siyyuma dikra, haleluya.

Vayyar Adonai ki senua lea, vechi ammay hi senua, veha bene senua lav beni maalya ninhu. vachazinan dechol inun beni maale millea nafku, veat amart ki senua lea. ella, vadday yovla ihu tadir alma deitkasseya, vechol milloy lav (bene)
307: Beitgalleya ninhu, uvegin kach, yaakov itkasseyayn minneh kol ovadoy.

Ta chaze, alma tattaa beitgalleya ihu, vehu sheruta decholla, lesalleka bedargoy. kema dechachma illaa hu sheruta decholla, hachi name alma tattaa, chachma ihu, vehi sheruta decholla. uvegin kach, karenan atta, (Shemot 138 amud bet) begin deihu shemitta, veitgalleya.

Vealma illaa deihu yovla, karena hu, dechol milloy beitkasseya inun. veraza demilla delea, dichtiv, (Bereshit 30:16) vayyishkav immah ballayla hu. veal da ketiv, (Bamidbar 18:23) veavad hallevi hu. begin leamshacha minneh birchan lecholla. hu, alma illaa deitkasseya tadir, veyaakov bemma deitkasseya la itdabbak biruteh, ella bemma deitgalleya, veraza da dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:24) vedavak beishto.

(Bereshit 29:31) vayyar Adonai ki senua lea. mehacha, desane bar nash eryayn deimmeh, (vaachavetayh) veyityached bar nash im immeh bechol atar vela yitchashash. veha itaru, ben mityached im immo. vecholla itkasse miyyaakov, dealma illaa la itgalleya kelal.

Ta chaze, begineh deyaakov itkeyyaym alma, vei tema ha vegineh deavraham, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 2) behibbaram, al tikre behibbaram ella beavraham. ella begineh deyaakov itkeyyaym avraham, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 29:22) ko amar Adonai el bet yaakov asher pada et avraham. umikkaddemat dena hava kudesha berich hu bane almin vechariv lon, kevan deata yaakov minneh ishtachlalu almin, vela itcharavu kekadmita, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 43:1) ko amar Adonai boraacha yaakov veyotzercha yisrael vegomer.

Ta chaze ma ketiv, (Shemot 4:23) beni bechori yisrael, uchetiv (sham) shallach et beni veyaavdeni, yisrael ikre ben lekudesha berich hu, begin deitdabbak beh, kema deat amer, (Mishlei 30:4) ma shemo uma shem beno ki teda.

Lea, kad olidat liruven ma ketiv, (Bereshit 29:32) vattikra et shemo reuven. reuven setam, begin deitkelil bitlat sitrin mitchabberan kechada, shimon velevi. may tama levi, kema deat amer, (Melachim 1 7) loyot, chibbura dechol sitrin.
Amar ribbi yehuda, mehacha, dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:3) yeter seet veyeter az, ketargumo becheruta, kehuneta, umalchuta. umalchu besitra digvura ihu, veal da reuven setam.

Amar ribbi abba reu ven setam, deitkelil beshimon velevi. lea hachi hava datah. (sefer acher reuta) dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:34) happaam yillave ishi elay ki yaladti lo shelosha vanim. begin dehava telata demitchabberan kechada.

Veta chaze, dehacha hu. deha reticha illaa, avahan vedavid malka deitchabbar behu, vechullehu arba inun retichin illain, raza dishma kaddisha. veal da, reuven shimon levi, levatar yehuda deyarit malchu, veal da, kullehu beatar da.

Uchetiv (sefer acher da batar da dichtiv) (Bereshit 29:35) happaam ode et Adonai vegomer (Bereshit 29:35) vattaamod milledet, begin dehacha ishtachlalu arba samchin. happaam ode et Adonai, may taama amra ode et Adonai behay, velav bechullehu. ella mehacha, kol zimna

Mattenittin. bene elyon, kaddishe elyonin, berichan (sefer acher beriran) dealma, mocha deegoza. kenashu leminda, ha tzippora nachitt bechol yoma, ittear beginta. shalhova denura begadpaha. bidaha telatta magroppeyayn sheninan kecharba. mappetchan genizin bida yemina.

Kare vechayil veamar, man minnechon di nehiru anpoy, di al venappak veittetakkif beilana dechayye, mata beanpoy, achid besharshoy, achil meibbeh mattik midduvesha, yahiv chayyin lenappesha, asvavta legarmeh.
Istammar mehirhura bisha, mehirhura dimshakker beilana dechayye, masiv nahara venachala mekora deyisrael, dihev motta lenappesha, utteviru legarmeh lett leh kiyyuma kelal.

Hirhura demasiv hahu mekora dileh, avid ilana deshikra, begin dehahu hirhura salka, veachlaf nappesha techott nappesha. ilana dechayye istallak, veilana demotta ittetakkif beh, nappesha mittamman mashicha.
308: Dichneset yisrael begaluta, shema kaddisha lav shelim hu. ta chaze, af al gav ditlat benin havu ad deolidat lihuda, la shelim kurseyay. uvegine kach happaam ode et Adonai, vela bechullehu, veal da vattaamod milledet. may (186 amud alef) vattaamod, dekayyma kurseyay al samchohi.

(Vattaamod ad hacha) vattaamod, deha ad hacha, vattaamod beyichuda chad, mikkan uletatta alma defiruda ihu. vei tema inun teren benin deolidat levatar, kegavvna da. la, deha inun terin beillen itchabberu, begin deshit sitrin dealma kechada inun.

Veta chaze, kullehu teresar shivtin, tikkune dichneset yisrael behay alma ninhu, leittakkena nehora illaa (77 amud alef) uchema kema deitchaze, velatava ikkera decholla leatreh. kullehu almin kegavvna chad kayyme, uvehay ishtachlal alma tattaa kegavvna dealma dilela.

Yissaschar zevulun, hacha ishtachlalu shit benin, shit sitrin dealma. kegavvna da, bene hashshefachot inun arba, veitchabberu beillen. veillen arba kishrin demitchabberan behu, veukemuha, veal da ketiv, (Melachim 1 7:25) vechol achorihem bayta, af al gav divne shefachot ninhu, bayta.

Ribbi chizkiya amar, i hachi, ha ittemar kol ma deolid alma tattaa, piruda ihu, deha ketiv, (Bereshit 2:10) umishsham yippared, ma tema beyosef uvinyamin, i tema dealma chad behanne, lav ihu. deha la nafku mealma illaa, vealma tattaa ma deolidat olidat letatta vela leela, vei hachi piruda ihu.

Ata ribbi abba uneshakeh. amar leh milla da satim ihu, deha alma illaa ittakkan bitresar deinun middileh. aval ta chaze, raza demilla, bechol zimna tzaddik mealma tattaa nafik veayil, beh ayil uminneh nafik. uvegin kach, itbene beatar da, veikkara hu leela veikkara hu letatta, (sefer acher tzaddik beh ayiyil beh nafik) uvealma tattaa

Behahu hirhura, miggo ilana dechayye, veittedabbak beilana demotta. anpin lett beh, la chama tava lealmin, yevesha ihu bela lachutta kelal. inbeh marir kelaana, aleh ittemar (Yirmeyahu 17:6) vehaya kearar baarava velo yire chi yavo tov vegomer.

Begin dehirhura tava salik leela, achid beilana dechayye, attekif beanpoy, achil meinbeh, kol kiddushin vechol birchan nappekin minneh. achsin chayyin lenappesheh veasvavta legarmeh, aleh ittemar (Yirmeyahu 17:8) vehaya keetz shattul al mayim veal yuval yeshallach sharashav velo yire ki yavo chom vegomer.
Kol millin dealma, azlin battar machshava vehirhura, veal da (Vayikra 11:44) vehittekaddishtem vihyittem kedoshim, begin dechol kiddushin dealma appik umashicha behirhura tava.

Man deistaav behirhura (Vayikra 84 amud alef, sham 56 amud alef) bisha, kad atte leizdavvevga beitteteh vshoy reutteh vehirhureh beitteta ochora, vzara zara behirhura ochora, da hu deachlaf dargin illain dilela, darga dekudesha begin darga dimsaava. kema dehirhura dileh avid chilluppin letatta, uf hachi avad chilluppin leela.
Kema deguppa dehahu bera deyolid, ikre ben temura. uf hachi benappesha ben temura ikre. deha la mashicha meshichu kaddisha behahu hirhura, venappesha dileh ittechallaf bedarga ochora.

Yaakov shelema decholla, galle kamme kudesha bericha hu dechol archoy bikshot havu, vehirhura dikshot hirher tadir becholla. behahu lelya dimshammesh beitteteh belea, hirhura (176 amud bet, Vayikra 292 amud alef) dileh berachel havatt. moshommesh belea vechashiv berachel, umekora dileh behahu hirhura dileh azla.

Velav ledata, deha la hava yada. begin kacha, la salik reuven bishma. kudesha bericha hu dehava yada, achme leh veamar, reu ven deitteylid bealma. val da ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 23:24) im yissatter ish bammistarim vaani lo erennu, al tikre erennu ella arennu, deyistakkelun beh. uvegin deittegle kammeh dekudesha bericha hu, deha lav ledata hava uveorach keshot hirher birutteh yaakov, la ippesal miggo shivtin kaddishin, dei lav hachi hav ippesal.
Uvegin dehirhura ikkara ihu veavid ovada, kudesha bericha hu dehava yada hahu hirhura, beattar deittedabbeka. behahi tippa
309: Ihu tadir leolam, ketiv, (Bereshit 35:18) vayhi betzet nafshah ki meta.

Ta chaze behay alma tattaa, tzaddik (Shemot 259 amud alef) beh ayil uminneh nafik, kad ayyil, ihu beraza deyosef hatztzaddik, kad nafik beraza devinyamin hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 35:18) vayhi betzet nafshah ki meta, man nafshah, da tzaddik denafik minnah.

Veda binyamin, nikra ben oni, dechashivat deolidat letatta bealma defiruda, veishtaaru chad sare beinun leela. ma ketiv veaviv kara lo binyamin ben yamin, deha istallak leela bealma illaa. dechad itavid yosef, binyamin (153 amud bet) ashlim atrih. veal da tzaddik bealma tattaa ayil venafak, begin kach yosef uvinyamin vechullehu terisar, kegavvna dilela beyichuda chad.

(Bereshit 29:35) happaam (178 amud bet) ode et Adonai, ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Tehillim 111:1) ode Adonai bechol levav besod yesharim veeda, bechol levav, bechol lev mibbae leh. ella, david beraza illaa dishma kaddisha, ka bae leh leodaa leh lekudesha berich hu, ode Adonai bechol levav beyetzer tov uveyetzer ra, veillen teren sitrin, chad yamina vechad semala.

Besod yesharim veeda, illen inun shear sitrin dehay alma, deha levav, kegavvna dedarom vetzafon. besod yesharim, illen inun shear sitre alma, deinun shit kegavvna dilela. veeda, da hu atar dihuda, uchetiv, (Tehillim 132:12) veedoti zo alammedem.

Uchetiv, (Hoshea 12:1) vihuda od rad im el vegomer. ketiv (Tehillim 138:1) odcha bechol libbi neged elohim azammerekka, hacha beatar chad kaamar, dichtiv neged elohim azammerekka. deha legabbe hay darga kaamar shirata, lechabbera leh bimina.

Ta chaze, yehuda achid bechol sitrin, achid bedarom veachid bemizrach. deha ihu missetar semala ka atya, (Shemot 223 amud alef) vesheruteh batztzafon veachid bedarom, begin deihu azil limina veitachid begufa, begin kach (Bereshit 29:35) happaam ode et Adonai. vattaamod milledet, vattaamod, dekayyma bekiyyuma dekayyma kedka yaot, deha ittakkan kolla reticha kaddisha.

Rabbi shimon nafak lekiryayta, izdamman leh rabbi abba verabbi chiyyay verabbi yose, kevan dechama lon, amar chaddetute deorayyta itzterich hacha, yatvu telata illen, (sefer acher yomin) kad baa lemezal, patach kol chad vechad kera.

Ribbi abba patach veamar, (bareasheyteyg) vaAdonai amar el avram achare hippared lot meimmo vegomer, sa na enecha uree vegomer. vechi lefum chezu deavraham yarit ara vela yattir. ad kamma chame bar nash, telat parse o arba o chamesh parse, veihu amar (Bereshit 13:15) ki et kol haaretz asher atta roe vegomer.
Ella, kevan dearba sitrin dealma chame, kol ara chame. deha arba sitre dealma, kelala dechol alma. tu, zekaf leh kudesha berich hu al ara deyisrael,

Kadmaa, istammar leh bechirutta, dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 Adonai:1) ki hu habbechor vegomer, nittena bechoratto leyosef. behahu attar dehirhura azla veittedabbak behahi tippa, tamman ittedabbak veittemasar hahu bechora. veittentilatt bechora meruven, veittemasar beattar dehirhura ittedabbak bah. berachel hirher veittedabbak reutta, berachel ittedabbak bechirutta, vecholla ittehaddar battar hirhura umachashava.

Kegavvna da, hirhura umachashava, avid ovada veittemshacha meshichu, bechol ma deittedabbak bar nash besittera, dichtiv, (Devarim 25:5) lo tihye shott hammett hachutztza leish zar, yevamah yavo aleha, vehacha itztzetricha hirhura ureutta leittedabbeka. uvehahu reutta umachashava, mashicha meshichu veavid ovada deitztzetricha, vela yishtetztze shema demitta mealma.

Vesittera da (Iyov la) im yasim elav libbo rucho venishmatto elav yeesof, deha vadday reutta umachashava, mashicha meshichu, veavid ovada bechol ma deitztzetricha. veal da, bitztzelotta itztzetricha reutta vehirhura lechavvevna, vchen bechol inun pulechanin dekudesha bericha hu, hirhura umachashava avid ovada, umashicha meshichu bechol ma deitztzetricha.
310: Veachme leh deihi keshira besitre dealma, vehava chame kolla. kegavvna da, man dechame leh lerabbi shimon, kol alma chame, chedvavta deela vetatta.

Patach ribbi chiyyay veamar (Bereshit 28:13-14) haaretz asher atta shochev aleha lecha ettennna ulezarecha, vechi hahu atar bilchodoy avtach leh kudesha berich hu, deha arba ammin o chamsha havu vela yattir. ella, bezimna hahu, beinun arba ammin, kafil leh kudesha berich hu kol ara deyisrael. ishtakkach hahu atar kelala dechol ara, uma hahu atar ihu kelala dechol ara, ribbi shimon deihu butzina dechol ara, al achat kamma vechamma deshakil kechol alma.

Patach ribbi yose veamar, happaam ode et Adonai, vechi bechullehu deolidat, la itchaze leodaa leh lekudesha berich hu ella behay. ella yehuda ihu bera reviaa lekurseyay, veihu ashlim lekurseyay. uvegin kach, yehuda bilchodoy, tikkuna dekurseyay usemacha dechullehu semachin. (nusach acher dahavo telat, avraham veyitzchak veyaakov ucheden ata david mihuda veashlim lekurseyay, veal kach ikre yehuda deihu shemma kaddisha 445 0 maregalevahey dechuresyyay) ribbi shimon denahir kol alma beorayyta vechamma butzinin naharin begineh, al achat kamma vechamma.

(Bereshit 30:14) vayyelech reuven bime ketzir chittim vayyimtza dudaim bassade. ribbi yitzchak patach veamar, (Tehillim 104:24) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai kullam bechachma asita mala haaretz kinyanecha. hay kera ukemuha, bechamma atar. ella, man yachil lemimne ovadoy dekudesha berich hu. deha kamma chelin umashshiryayn, meshanyayn da min da, delet lon chushebna. vechullehu bezimna chada, kemarzefa deappik zikin lechol sitrin bezimna chada. kach kudesha berich hu, appik kamma zinin umashshiryayn meshanyayn da min da, delet lon chushebna vechullehu bezimna chada.

Ta chaze, bedibbura uverucha kechada, itavid alma, dichtiv (Tehillim 33:6) bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu uveruach piv kol tzevaam. bidvar Adonai, da dibbura. uveruach piv, da rucha. da vela da la azil, veitkelil da beda, venafik minayyhu kamma chelin lechelin, umashshiryayn lemashshiryayn, vecholla bezimna chada.

Ta chaze kad baa kudesha berich hu lemivre almin, appik chad nehora setimaa. demin hahu nehora, nafkin venaharin kol inun nehorin deitgalleyayn. umehahu nehora, nafkin veitpashshetu veitavidu shear nehorin veihu alma illaa.
Tu, itpashshat hay nehora illaa, veavid umana, nehora dela nahir, veavid alma tattaa. uvegin deihu nehora dela nahir, bae leitkashshera leela,

Sitre tora vayyelecha reuven bime ketztzir chitim vayyimtztza dudaim basade vegomer. tenan, kos shel beracha la ittebarcha, ella vistar yemina. uvegin kacha, beod deittear yemina legabbe kos shel beracha, semala la tesayyea tamman. deha yemina ashkach illa behahu kos, leitteara legabbe alma illaa.
Vesittera da, vayyelecha reuven, da sitra dedarom. begin kacha digleh baddarom, deihu resha litteresar techumin, vetiuveteh distar darom, leashkacha illa vetikrova lematronitta levarcha lah.

Ma ketiv, vayyimtztza dudaim basade, azal lechappesa bechol inun genizin dilah, veashkach behay sade inun dudaim, vealayyhu ittemar (Shir HaShirim 7:14) haddudaim nattenu reach, veinun teren (152 amud alef) keruvim, deinun tikkunin dilah, leitteara ittearu leela, deha bechol inun tikkunin dehay sade, lett tikkuna deyittear legabbe ela, bar keruvim.

Setar darom emattay ittear legabbah, leashkacha illa levarcha lah. bime ketztzir chitim, bezimna dippeligatt chulak shelala leuchelusaha, vechullehu chatztzede chakla. miyyad vayyave ottam el lea immo, salik recha, veittearu dilhon legave alma illaa, alma deittekasseya, begin deittear (nusach acher deyittear) birchan lealma tattaa.

Vechad ittebarcha, inun dudaim naktin veyahavin lechol almin, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:14) haddudaim nattenu reach veal petachenu kol megadim. kad inun nattenu reach, hahu recha nakit leh setar darom leitteara legabbe alma illaa, miyyad al petachenu kol megadim, vechol tuva la chasir (sefer acher mikkolla) mealma.
311: Bae leitkashshera letatta, uvekishshura diltatta, itkashshar leitnehara bekishshura dilela.
Vehay nehora dela nahir, bekishshura dilela, appik kol chelin umashshiryayn lezinin saggiin, hada hu dichtiv ma rabbu maasecha Adonai kullam bechachma asita vegomer.

Vechol ma di veara, hachi name leela. velet lach milla zeera behay alma, dela talyay bemilla ochora illaa deitpakkeda aleh leela, begin dechad itar hay letatta, itar hahu deitpakkeda aleh leela, decholla itachad da beda.

Ta chaze ketiv, (Bereshit 30:14) teni na li middudae benech. lav dudaim olidu lah lerachel, ella kudesha berich hu ka gilgel milla al yede deinun dudaim. begin deyippuk yissashchar, deachid beorayyta yattir mikkullehu shivtin. begin deha rachel achida beh beyaakov, la shavkat leh legabbe lea. hada hu dichtiv (Bereshit 30:15) hameat kachtech et ishi, uchetiv lachen yishkav immach hallayla tachat dudae benich.

Inun garmu deyippuk yissashchar lealma, begin desalik recha deorayyta, kamme kudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv (Shir HaShirim 7:14) haddudaim natnu reach vegomer. uchetiv, (Bereshit 30:16) vayyishkav immah ballayla hu. hu (124 amud bet) vadday, veha ukemuha, dealma illaa. hu, desatim vela galya, begin deha orayyta mealma (86 amud bet) illaa nafkat.

Uvechol atar, alma illaa. hu, dela itgalleya, veha ittemar, (Bamidbar 18:23) veavad hallevi hu, begin leamshacha minneh birchan lecholla, veyissashochar beh itachid, veal da karinan etz hachayyim, ilana deinun chayyin illain, deikre hu velo atta.

Vei tema deillen dudaim patchu meaha derachel. lav, deha ketiv, (Bereshit 30:22) vayyishma eleha elohim vayyiftach et rachamah, kudesha berich hu, vela milla ochora. begin deinun dudaim, af al gav dechela dilhon leela. behahu chela dilhon, la itmanne pekida divnin, deha benin bemazzala talyayn, velav bemilla ochora.
Vei tema deha inun lemaggana itberiu, lav, deha afillu

La ittear legabbe alma illaa, ella kad inun dudaim yahavin recha limina, kevan deinun yahavin recha limina, vimina ittear legabbe alma illaa, miyyad alma tattaa ittear leshaala ma deitztzetricha. ma ketiv, (Bereshit 30:14) vattomer rachel el lea teni na li middudae benicha, hav li birchan mehahu ittearu, deinun dudaim deittear legabbe setar yemina.

Keden alma illaa bechedva, beshiashu, attiv legabbah, veamratt hameat kachtecha ett ishi, keimma legabbe beratta. vi hachi baala dealma illaa yaakov ihu. lav hachi, ella tiuveta deabba tadir, lav ihu, ella legabbe beratta dena, (deihi) dehay batt, rechimu dileh legabbah tadir, begin deihi batt yechidaa ben shitt benin, ulechol inun shitt benin, palig lon chulakin unevazbezan umattenan, velah la palig, velett lah yerutta kelum, veal kol da, ihu ashgach bah betiuveta urechimu yattir mikkolla.

Birchimu dileh kara lah batt, la sappik leh da, vekara lah achott, la sappik leh da, kara lah em beshum immeh, la sappik leh da, kara lah bishmeh, dichtiv, (Iyov 28:12) vehachachma meayin timmatztze, chachma vday. veal da, alma illaa amratt legabbah, hameat kachtecha ett ishi, dechol rechimu dileh ittemshacha lacha legabbacha veal da. beshaashuo urechimu imma legabbe beratta.

Ma attivatt ihi, (Bereshit 30:15) lachen yishkav immacha hallayla. bechol attar, lachen, shevua ihi. yishkav, mahu yishkav. ella shechiva bechol attar tikkuna denukeva legabbe dechura, leoola vah tziyyura deattevavn kullehu, veda ihu yishkav, yish kav. ysh da ihu alma illaa, (sefer acher 22 raza) raza deorayyta nekuda temira, deittear legabbah 22 attevavn, veda hu yishkav, 310 alma deatte, dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:21) lehanechil ohavay yesh. 22 nekuda illaa deail kol 22 attevvn. raza dechol orayyta.
312: Lemilla da, siyyua inun leinun demitakkeve, velav inun akaran, vela itgezar alayyhu ella bemazzala.
Veda hu yishkav, yishkav immacha yaakov la ketiv, ella yishkav immacha. hahu temira deittechaze leitteara legabbacha, vecholla beittearu deinun (dechullehu) dudaim, vcholla ketiv birchimu.

(Bereshit 30:16) vayyavo yaakov min hasade baerev. vayyavo yaakov, da tippeerett kaddisha, mehahu sade denakit kol birchan, dichtiv beh (Bereshit 27:27) asher beracho Adonai. baerev, ammay baerev, ela baerev, dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:63) vayyetztze yitztzechak lasuach basade lippenott erev. bezimna deittear yitztzechak avoy legabbe hay sade, venakit leh, deha yitztzechak la ittear legabbe hay sade, kevan deistallak yaakov mittamman baerev, shavik hay sade leyitztzechak avoy, veihu salik behahu zimna legabbe ela.

Ma ketiv, (Bereshit 30:16) vattetztze lea likratto. imma illaa legabbe bera yechida. vattomer elay tavo, techott gadpay levarcha lacha, uleravava lacha betappenukin veiddunin illain. ha idan raava veinnuga lemehav lacha nayycha derucha illaa, legabbe hahu sade, ad la yittokkad betukepa deyitztzechak.

Kevan denakta leyaakov techott gadpaa, keden (sham) vayyishkav immah ballayla hu. hu. desattim mikkolla. hu. dechol birchan vechol kiddushin nappeke mittamman. yaakov la ketiv ella hu. man deittechaze leitteara legabbah.

Vead dela zammin legabbah techott gadpaha, man denakit inun kaddishan (kedushan) uvirchan la ittemle minnekuda temira, hahu alma illaa. veal da dudaim mitteare kolla, vecholla kegavvna deraza illaa. reuven may reuven, kudesha bericha hu shavvi shemahan beara, dichtiv (Tehillim 46:9) lechu chazu mippealott Adonai asher sam shammott baartz. (74 kan sitre tora).

(Bereshit 30:16) vattetze lea likrato vattomer elay tavo vegomer. hay milla chatzifuta ihu. lav ihu hachi, ela mehacha olifna, invevtanuta delea, dela amra kamme achatah middi, veihi akdimat leorcha, veamra leh bachashay, veoda leh. deha virshuta derachel hava, dichtiv, (sham) ki sachor secharticha, merachel netilat reshu, uvegin dela yavish beenaa derachel, amra leh levar vela beveta.

Vela od ella pitcha mishkena delea (levar), nafkat levar, veayylat leh leyaakov befitcha dilvar, ad la yeul lemishkena derachel. may tama, begin dela tema milla kamme derachel, vela tachtzif kamme achataha. vela od, ella amra lea, i yeul yaakov bemishkena derachel, lav din hu leafkeh mittamman, begin kach akdimat leh levar.

Vechol hay lamma, ella lea rucha dekudesha itarat bah, veyadat dechol hanne shivtin illain, kullehu kaddishin, yifkun minnah, vedachkat shata, bachavivuta lekudesha berich hu, uvegin kach hi karat lon shemahan, beraza dechachmeta.

Rabbi chiyyay verabbi yose, havu azle beorcha, amar ribbi yose lerabbi chiyyay, bechol zimna (deanan) deazlinan beorcha, velaenan beorayyta, kudesha berich hu marchish lan nissin, vehasheta orcha da arich lan, nitassak beorayyta, vekudesha berich hu yizdavvevg bahadan.

Patach ribbi chiyyay veamar, (Shemot 12:18) barishon bearbaa asar yom lachodesh baerev tochlu matztzot, uchetiv, (dabeham 16) shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot lechem oni, lechem ani ketiv, hay milla itaru bah chavrayay. aval ta chaze, kad havu yisrael bemitzrayim, havu birshuta ochora. kad baa kudesha berich hu lekarva lon legabbeh, yahav lon atar delechem oni. lechem ani, man ani. da david malka, dichtiv beh (tehillim 46) ki ani veevyon ani.

Vehay lechem oni ikre matztza, nukeva bela dechura, miskenuta have, itkerivu legabbe matztza bekadmita, kevan dekarivu lon yattir, ayyil lon kudesha berich hu bedargin ochoranin, veitchabbar dechura benukeva. ucheden, matztza kad itchabberat bidchura ikre mitzva betosefet vav, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 30:11) ki hammitzva hazzot. begini kach, matztza bekadmita, ulevatar mitzva.

Ad dehavu azle, shemau chad kala deamar, tufesra dekatnnun, akiman beorcha, setu leela, la techotun bekusetra dekitra diltatta. amar ribbi yose, shema minah, dekudesha berich hu bae lenatra orchin. seliku leela, vealu bechad tura, ben tinnarin takkifin, amru, hoil vekudesha berich hu baa beorcha da, milla nechome o nissa (tarchesh) itrechish lan.

Azle, yatve gabbe bekie detinnara. salik lon chad bar nash, tevavhu, amar ribbi yose man ant. amar meanshe arka ana, amar leh, vetamman it bene nasha, amar in, vezarin vechatzdin, minnayyhu bechezu ochora meshanyayn minnay, vesalikna gabbayychu, leminda minnayychu, ma shemeh deara deattun bah.

Amar leh, eretz, begin dehacha eretz hachayyim sharya, dichtiv, (Iyov 28:5) eretz mimmenna yetze lachem, mehay yetze lechem, bishar ara la yetze lachem, vei nafik, lav mishshivat hamminin. addehachi al leatreh. tevavhu, amru vday kudesha berich hu bae leitara lan bemilla.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, vadday al hay kera deamarta, dachirna deolifna missavay, chad milla illaa. befesach, deyahav lon kudesha berich hu leyisrael lechem da, meara dechayye, ulevatar lechem min hashshamayim, lechem da, veha okimna milla.
313: Nash, kad nafik lehay alma, la yada middi, ad deatim nahama. kevan deachil nahama, itar leminda uleishtemoda. kach kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, la havu yade midde, ad deatim lon kudesha berich hu lechem mehay eretz, dichtiv eretz mimmenna yetze lachem, ucheden alu yisrael, leminda uleishtemoda leh lekudesha berich hu. vinuka la yada, vela ishtemoda, ad detaim nahama dehay alma.

Yisrael la yadu, vela ishtemodu bemillin dilela, ad deachlu lechem illaa, ucheden yadu veishtemodu behahu atar uvaa kudesha berich hu deyindeun yisrael yattir, behahu atar deitchaze lehay eretz. vela yachilu, ad detaamu lechem, mehahu atar, uman ihu, shamayim. dichtiv, (Shemot 16:4) hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim, ucheden yadu veistakkalu behahu atar, vead deachlu lechem mehahu atar, (sefer acher vead dela achlu lechem meillen atre) la yadu middi vela ishtemodu.

Ata rabbi yose uneshakeh. amar, vadday al da itar lon kudesha berich hu behay, veal da sheruta deyisrael leminda, lechem hava. kamu veazlu, ad dehavu azlu, chamu tere darmusekin, chad dechar vechad nukeva. amar ribbi yose, let lan milla bealma, dela have dechar venukeva, vechol ma di veara, hachi name beyamma.

Patach ribbi yose veamar, (Bereshit 30:16) vayyavo yaakov min hassade baerev vattetze lea likrato vegomer, vattetze lea likrato, mena yadat. ha amru degaa chamara, velea yadat, venafkat leh, vegarim leh denafak minnah yissashchar. hada hu dichtiv yissashchar chamor garm, al tikre garm, ella garam dechamara garma leh. amrat lea, vadday yadana dei yeul yaakov bemishkena derachel, let li leafaka leh, ella orich leh hacha, veyeul bemishkani.
(Bereshit 30:16) ki sachor secharticha bedudae beni, may bedudae beni, begin denicha leh leyaakov al da, deillen mesayyin leolada. veyaakov hava yada, demilla la kayyma baddudaim, ella leela.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 113:9) moshivi akeret habbayit em habbanim semecha halleluya. amar ribbi chiyyay rucha dekudesha kaamar, moshivi (154 amud alef) akeret habbayit, da rachel. em habbanim semecha, da lea. moshivi akeret habbayit, da alma tattaa. em habbanim semecha (haleluyah), da alma illaa, begine (154 amud alef) kach halleluya.

Amar ribbi yehuda, kol illen shivtin, tikkunin diltatta inun, vechullehu kegavvna dilela. ta chaze, ki sachor secharticha, lenasva minneh gufa uman ihu tora. sachor secharticha, lecha, legufach mammash. sachor
314: Mehacha, man delae beorayyta, achsin alma deate veachsin achsanta deyaakov. achsin alma deate, dichtiv yissashchar yesh sachar, (Yirmeyahu 31:16) ki yesh sachar lifullatech. uchetiv, (Mishlei 8:21) lehanechil ohavay yesh veotzrotehem amalle.

(Bereshit 30:20) ki yaladti lo shishsha vanim. amar ribbi chizkiyya, illen ela vetatta vearba sitrin dealma. uman dearich beechad, bae leh leamlacha lekudesha berich hu leela vetatta, ulearba sitre dealma, vehayeynu echad.

Amar ribbi chizkiyya, ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 2) al hare vater, uchetiv, (Shir HaShirim 8) al hare vesamim, man inun hare vesamim. illen shit benin delea, deachlalan shit ochoranin, veinun teresar, veinun shit. begin (241 amud alef) dechol chad kalil bechavreh, velea alayyhu, lekayyma (Tehillim 113:9) em habbanim semecha halleluya.

Veal da ketiv, (Devarim 22:6) lo tikkach haem al habbanim, begin deihu alma deitkasseya, vela itgalleya, veal da (sham) shallach teshallach et haem veet habbanim tikkach lach. begin deihu alma deitkasseya, vela itgalleya kelal.

Veet habbanim tikkach lach, hayeynu dichtiv, (Devarim 4:32) ki sheal na leyamim rishonim vegomer (sham) ulemiktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim. vechol hanne, ikrun hare vesamim, mikkan uletatta ikrun hare vater, (29 amud bet) dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) umishsham yippared, vehaya learbaa rashim, ture defiruda.

Amar ribbi yesa, bene hashshefachot keshiru kishrin, (154 amud alef) arba kishrin deitzterichu letikkuna. veamar ribbi elazar, divgin kach nafke levar inun kishrin, veaf al gav dechullehu chad, umikkan ulehala kullehu chad, beorach meshar. veal da, kullehu shivtin salkin besahaduta dilela, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 122:4) sheshsham alu shevatim shivte yah edut leyisrael lehodot leshem Adonai.

Veamar ribbi elazar, ketiv, (Bereshit 30:25) vayhi kaasher yalda rachel et yosef vegomer, ma chama yaakov lemehach leorcheh, kad ityelid yosef, vead la ityelid yosef la vaa lemehach leorcheh. ella ha ukemuha, dechama deityelid sitna deesav.

Veta chaze, yosef ashlim ducheteh batreh veyosef zache leh, deikre tzaddik, vehacha siyyuma degufa. kevan dechama yaakov, deishtelim gufa, baa gufa lemehach leorcheh, vesiyyuma degufa hu berit. veim kol da binyamin ashlim chushebna, deveh ishtelimu teresar.

Vei tema, vechi la hava yada yaakov, dead kean la ishtallimu shivtin, af al gav deityelid yosef, may tama la orich ad deyityelid binyamin veyishtallimu shivtin. ella, yaakov bechachmeta avad, umilla yada. amar, vadday i ishtallimu hacha kullehu shivtin, ha yedana detikkuna dilela sharya alayyhu kedka yeut. uveara da, la libbae deyishtelimu, ella beara kaddisha.

Ta chaze dehachi hu, dechullehu teresar shivtin, tikkuna dealma tattaa ninhu, vechevan deityelid binyamin, mitat rachel, venatla ducheta hay alma tattaa, leittakkana behu. veal da la ityelid binyamin, ella beara kaddisha, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 48:7) vaani bevoi mippaddan meta alay rachel beeretz kenaan badderech, vetamman mitat rachel venatla ducheta, hay alma tattaa, leityashsheva beveta shelemata, vechol zimna derachel kayyma, alma tattaa la ittakkena behu, mitat rachel, natla (davar acher 33 leella) beta bishlimu.

Vei tema, lea ammay la mitat behahu zimna. ella begin deveta bealma tattaa (nusach acher illaa) ihu, vecholla minneh havu leittakkena, velav mealma illaa (nusach acher tattaa), uvegin kach la mitat behahi shata. vechol ovadoy delea beitkasseya inun, begin dealma ilaa ihu beitkasseya, velav beitgalleya, uvegin kach la idkar mitatah delea, kemitatah derachel.

Veta chaze, dehachi hu vadday. begin dealma illaa, kol milloy beitkasseya, vealma tattaa kol milloy beitgalleya. begin kach, itkasseya lea bimarta dechafelta, verachel begilluyay deorcha, da besitra, veda beitgalleya. uveitkasseya alma illaa itreshim, dichtiv, (Bereshit 30:13) vattomer lea beashri ki ishruni vanot, uvegin kach kara shemeh asher.
315: (Begin kach kol birchan ditren almin beitgalleya vabeatekaseya veim kol da). uvegin da, kolla chad, deha kolla have mealma illaa. hachi name uvechol atar, teren almin, da beitgalleya veda beitkasseya. veanan la mevarchinan lekudesha berich hu, ella bitren almin, dichtiv, (Tehillim 106:48) baruch Adonai elohe yisrael (153 amud bet) min haolam vead haolam. begine kach, alma illaa karenan 12, vekarenan lealma (Shemot 138 amud bet) tattaa atta, begin deihu baruch mealma illaa, al yeda detzaddik. hada hu dichtiv (Tehillim 135:21) baruch Adonai mitztziyyon shochen yerushalam vegomer. vadday mitztziyyon ihu baruch.
Ta chaze, kegavvna da (Shemot la) Adonai Adonai teren almin (nasha 138 amud alef) ninhu, da beitgalleya veda beitkasseya, veal da pasik tama begavvavyeyhu, umealma da ad alma da, kolla chad.

(Bereshit lo) vayhi kaasher yalda rachel et yosef vegomer, amar (nidpas daf 165 amud alef besitre tora) ribbi yehuda, ta chaze, shelemuta deyaakov dela vaa lemezal ella birshuteh delavan. vei tema, zimna acharina ammay la azil birshuteh. ela begin dedachil yaakov, dela yishbok leh, veyishtelimu teresar shivtin beara ochora. veal da kevan dechama demata shata devinyamin, barach. kema deat amer, vayyivrach hu vechol asher lo.

Dechevan deityelid binyamin, itkashrat shechinta bechullehu shivtin, venatla beta bechullehu. veyaakov hava yada beraza dechachmeta, dechad yishtallimu teresar shivtin, dishchinta titkashshet vetitkashsher behu, verachel tamut, veihi natla beta.

Ta chaze, hachi olifna, alma tattaa itchaze leh leyaakov kema deitchaze lemoshe, ella dela yechilat, ad dehavu teresar shivtin beveta leitkashshera behu, ucheden itdakkiat (nusach acher atedacheyyt) rachel, venatla ihi veta bechullehu shivtin, vahavat ikkera deveta, ucheden (Tehillim 113:9) moshivi akeret habbayit vadday.

Amar yaakov, ha mata zimna, deishtelimu teresar shivtin, vadday alma dilela yechot hu leveta leitkashshera behu, umiskenuta da itdachyay kammeh. i tamut hacha, la ippuk mehacha lealmin. vela od, ella veara da, la itchaze leashlama veta. begin kach vayhi kaasher yalda vegomer, ad la ishtallimu shivtin.

Shama ribbi shimon, amar, vadday kol milloy derabbi yehuda shappir, veda salik al kolla. vei tema ammay la azal leh leorcheh miyyad. ella, kol zeman derachel la mitabbera mibbinyamin, itakkav tamman. kevan demata zimna devinyamin, arak vela vaa reshuta, begin dela yitakkev tamman veyitchabber yaakov bechulehu shivtin, beatra (dela) deitzterich.

Ribbi abba patach, (Shemot 4:18) vayyelech moshe vayyashav el yeter chotno vegomer. ta chaze, moshe rae ana deyitro chamuy hava, vediyyureh hava beh. vechad bae lemezal, la azal ella birshuta dideh. veyaakov dehava shelim vediyyureh hava tadir immeh delavan, ammay la vaa reshuta minneh. ella ha ittemar dela yegalgel lavan immeh gilgulin veyishtaar tamman. deha bekadmita amar leh, umiyyad gilgel aleh gilgulin veishtaar tamman, vehasheta dachil minneh.

Aval yitro, la hava hachi legabbe moshe. begin delavan charasha hava, uvecharasha hava kol ovadoy legabbe deyaakov, vehasheta la vaa yaakov leitakkeva tamman, deha kudesha berich hu amar leh (Bereshit 31:3) shuv el eretz avotecha vegomer. veal da la vaa leitakkeva ulemishbak pikkuda demareh.

Ta chaze ketiv, (Bereshit 30:22) vayyizkor elohim et rachel vegomer, patach veamar, (Tehillim 46:1) lamnatztzeach livne korach al alamot shir. hay kera, it leistakkala beh, deraza dechachmeta ihu. vechol hanne shirin vetushebchan, dehavu amre bene korach, kullehu mechadtin inun shirin vetushebchan dehavu millekaddemin, vechen kol inun shirin vetushebchan deamar david vechol inun dehavu immeh, kullehu havu beraza illaa, beraza dechachmeta.
Ta chaze, avad kudesha berich hu alma tattaa kegavvna dealma illaa, vechol inun sidderin desidderu david ushelomo bereh, vechol inun nevie keshot kullehu
316: Ta chaze, kegavvna deikka mishmarot beara, hachi name birkia. dimzammere lemarayyhu, veamre shirata tadir. vechullehu kayymin illen lokovel illen, vecholla besidderan deshirin vetushebchan, veha ukemuha chavrayay.

Alamot shir, may alamot shir. ela kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 6:8) shishshim hemma melachot ushemonim pilagshim vaalamot en mispar. may vaalamot en mispar. kema deat amer (Iyov 25:3) hayesh mispar ligdudav. uvegin delet lon chushebna, ketiv vaalamot en mispar.
Vechullehu shurin shurin, mesacharan sedarin, illen lokovel illen, lezammera uleshabbacha lemarehon, veillen inun alamot shir. uvegin deit alamot dela mezammerin keillen, illen ikrun alamot shir.

Telat (nidpas pikkude 228 amud alef) sidderin mitparshan lechol setar led sitre alma, uvechol siddera vesiddera deihi lechol setar, telat sidderin ochoranin. siddera kadmaa delistar mizrach, telat sidrin inun. veinun tisha sidderin, begin dechol siddera meinun telat, it leh telat sidderin, veishtakkachu deinun tisha, vechamma elef verivvan techotayyhu.

Hanne sidderin tisha, kulehu mitnahage beatvavn reshiman, vechol siddera isteche leinun atvavn reshiman, (sefer acher veha ukemuha vechen lechol sidra vesidra, vechullehu natle beatvavn reshimin veillen illae meillen vakeyymaan illen al illen) umitchabberan kullehu, veamre shirata. vechad inun atvavn parche go avira derucha (hahu) dimmanna al kolla, keden inun natle, veshirata itbassam, vechad at itbattash mittatta. vehahu at salka venachata uteren atvavn parche alayyhu, vehay at mittatta, salka siddera mittatta leela veitchabbar behu, veitavidu telat atvavn, kullehu lefum atvavn Yahu, deinun telat go aspaklarya hameira. meillen itparshu telat sidderin veinun teren atvavn, vehahu at desalka, mitchabbera immehon veinun telat.

Ta chaze, inun teren atvavn illain, desalkin baavira, inun kelilan da beda, rachamay bedina. uvegin kach inun teren, veinun mealma illaa beraza didchura, vehay desalka veitchabbera immehon ihi nukeva, veitkelilat betarvavyyhu. kegavvna denukeva itkelilat bitre sitre, bimina uvismala, veitchabberat behu, hachi name hay at nukeva, deitchabberat bitre atvavn ochoranin, veinun bitren sitrin, illen illain, veda letatta, vecholla ihu chad, dechar venukeva. (bar) dechad itbere alma, deinun atvavn mealma illaa ninhu, deinun olidu kol ovadin letatta, kegavvevna dilhon mammash, uvegin kach man deyada lon veizdehar behu, rachim leela urachim letatta.

Ribbi shimon amar, illen atvavn kullehu, dechar venukeva, leitkelala kechada beraza demayin illain umayin tattain, vecholla chad, veda ihu yichuda shelim. uvegin kach, man deyada lehu, veizdehar behu, zakkaa ihu chulakeh behay alma uvealma deate, begin deihu ikkara deyichuda shelim kedka yeut. telat telat missitra da umissitra da, beyichuda chada bishlimu decholla. vechullehu raza desiddera illaa kedka chaze, kegavvna dilela, dehahu siddera telat telat beraza chada.

Siddera tinyayna delistar darom, telat sidderin inun lehahu sitra. vechol siddera vesiddera telat telat, veinun tisha, kema deittemar. veatvavn itpelagu hachi. lechol sitre, leitchabbera kolla kechad, begin deit atvavn beraza denukeva, veatvavn beraza didchura, veitchabbaru kullehu kechada, vehavu chad beraza dishma kaddisha shelim. ulegabbayyhu sidderin memannan telat telat, kema deittemar. vecholla nafka missiddera deavahan dilela, kesiddera deittakkena atvavn dishma kaddisha Yahu, kema deittemar. hanne sidderin kullehu, mitnahage beillen atvavn yedian, venatle behu, vechamma chelin verivvavn kullehu letatta, denatle veitnahage besiddera da.
Siddera telitaa delistar tzafon, bitlat sidderin inun lehahu sitra, veinun tisha. uvitlat sitrin telat telat lechol setar inun tisha, veinun sidrin mittelat sitrin kema deittemar.
317: Beraza deatvavn deinun shiva veesrin. veaf al gav deinun teren veesrin, shelimu deatvavn inun shiva veesrin. vehachi siddura desidderin illen. shiva veesrin litlat telat sidderin lechol setar. veishtakkachu illen 3 mehay sitra deinun 9, veillen telat mehay sitra deinun tisha, veillen telat dehay sitra deinun tisha. ishtakkachu kullehu shiva veesrin.

Veraza deillen shiva veesrin, inun tisha atvavn (inun) deinun beraza denukeve, leitchabbera behu nukeva, im inun temane sare sitre ochoranin, beraza deittamar (nusach acher didchar), vecholla ihu kedka chaze.

Ta chaze, kegavvna deinun atvavn illain dealma illaa, hachi name atvavn ochoranin letatta. atvavn ilain ravrevin, veatvavn tattain zeirin, vecholla da kegavvna da, vechol hanne razin, beraza didchar venukeva, kolla chad bishlimu.

(Bereshit 30:22) vayyizkor elohim et rachel, deha bemazzala talya, uvegin kach ketiv bah zechira. (Bereshit 21:1) vaAdonai pakad et sara, lav mimmazzala hava. vei tema deha benin bemazzala talyayn vela letatta, hacha besara lav bemazzala hava. ella vaAdonai ketiv, kolla kechada.

I hachi ammay ketiv pekida, ella vadday zechira, (da) havat mikkadmat dena, veitmasar maftecha da letatta, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 17:21) veet beriti akim et yitzchak asher teled lecha sara lammoed hazze vegomer. ulevatar kegavvna da, vechevan deidkar, beraza dilela, levatar ittemar beraza denukeva pekida, lemeheve kelala decholla kechada.

Vayyizkor elohim et rachel. rabbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Shemot 6:Adonai) vegam ani shamati et naakat bene yisrael asher mitzrayim maavidim otam vaezkor et beriti. vaezkor ha zechira, begin deihu leela. dehay mazzala deihu leela bidchura, ata al pekida deihi begaluta letatta venukeva. kegavvna da vayyizkor elohim et rachel, kema deat amer vaezkor et beriti.

Ta chaze, ketiv, (Shemot 3:16) pakod pakadti etchem, vechi pakod pakadti, veha pekida benukeva kayyma uvehahu zimna begaluta havat, veihi amrat pakod pakadti. ella hacha it leistakkala, veraza dechachmeta hacha veihi begaluta hech itchaze lemoshe hacha, vehech amrat pakod pakadti.

Ella hachi olifna shimsha kad nahir, ihu bishmaya, vetukepeh vecheleh shalta al ara bechol atar. kegavvna da (Yeshayahu 6:3) melo chol haaretz kevodo, bezimna demakdesha kaim, melo chol haaretz kevodo, da ara kaddisha. vehasheta deyisrael begaluta, ihi leela, vetukepa sachara lehu leyisrael leagana alayyhu, veaf al gav deinun beara ochora.

Veta chaze, shechinta letatta ushechinta leela. shechinta leela bitresar techume retichin kaddishin, uteresar chevavn illain. shechinta letatta bitresar shivtin kaddishin, ucheden itkelilat shechinta leela vetatta, vecholla bechad zimna kechada. veaf al gav debzimna deyisrael begaluta letatta, la ittakkanat leela, hachi name la ittakkanat, begin diltatta la ittakkanat, veda hu begaluta immehon deyisrael, deihi begaluta immehon.

Bemma ittakkanat, lemalka demit bereh, ma avad kafa leh learseh al evla divreh, vela atkin leh learseh, ella natal kuvin vedardarin, veattil techot arseh, veshachiv aleh, kach kudesha berich hu, kevan deitgalu yisrael, veitcharev makdesha, natal kuvin vedardarin veshavve techoteh, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 3:2) vayyera malach Adonai elav belabbat esh mittoch hassene. begin deyisrael havu begaluta.

Pakod pakadti etchem, man dela kayyma birshuteh, ma pakkid, uma avid. ella pakod milleela, pakadti milletatta, may tama, begin dehay zechira havat alah mikkaddemat dena, dichtiv vaezkor et beriti. kevan dichtiv vaezkor, ha zechira itmena ala, ubbegin kach amrat levatar pakod pakadti.
318: Deha simana naktat mikkaddemat dena. kegavvevna da sara dichtiv, (Bereshit 21:1) vaAdonai pakad et sara. aval hacha rachel dela idkarat mikkaddemat dena, la ittemar bah pekida ella zechira, vecholla bizchira ihu, beraza demazzala.

Ribbi yehuda veribbi chizkiyya, havu azle mikkappotkiya lelod, vehava ribbi yehuda rachiv, veribbi chizkiyya al ragloy, addehachi nachat ribbi yehuda, amar mikkan ulehala nitassek beorayyta, kema dichtiv, (Devarim 32:3) havu godel lelohenu.

Amar leh illu havena telata, yaot hu dechad yema, uteren yativu leh. amar leh, hanne mille bevirchan. begin deidkar chad shema dekudesha berich hu, uteren yativu leh. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 32:3) ki shem Adonai ekra havu godel lelohenu. ki shem Adonai ekra, da chad dimvarech, havu godel lelohenu, illen teren ochoranin. aval beorayyta afillu tere yatve veyahave revu vetukepa deshivcha deorayyta lekudesha berich hu.

Amar leh ribbi chizkiyya, legabbe birchan ammay telat. amar leh, ha ukemuha veittemar, dichtiv havu godel lelohenu. aval raza demilla hacha, deha kol razin devirchan hachi ihu, chad levarcha uteren leatava, begin disallak (deyistelik) shevacha dekudesha berich hu beraza ditlata. chad mevarech uteren (imre amen) deodu, veda hu kiyyuma devirchan, uveraza illaa kedka yeut, uveraza ditlat kema deukemuha.

Ad dehavu azle, amar ribbi yehuda, taninan, it zechira letav, veit zechira levish, it pekida letav, veit pekida levish. it zechira letav, kema deukemuha, dichtiv (Vayikra 26:45) vezacharti lahem berit rishonim vegomer. (Bereshit 8:1) vayyizkor elohim et noach. (Shemot 2:24) vayyizkor elohim et berito. veit zechira levish, dichtiv, (Tehillim 78:39) vayyizkor ki vasar hemma ruach holech velo yashuv. pekida letav, dichtiv, (Shemot 3:16) pakod pakadti etchem. pekida levish, dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:33) ufakadti beshevet pisham uvingaim avonam. vechullehu razin illain.

Kol hanne zechira ufekida letav, illen inun dargin yedian. raza dimhemnuta dechar venukeva raza chada, zechira ufekida, veillen inun letav. zechira ufekida levish, illen inun raza desitra ochora, dekayyma beraza deelohim acherim, dechar venukeva kechada, zechira behay, ufekida behay, veillen inun dekayymin tadir levish. veillen lokovel illen. mehacha nafke kol raze dimhemnuta vechol kiddushin illain, kema deukemuha. umehacha nafke kol zinin bishin vechol mota, vechol sitrin vezinin bishin bealma veukemuha. veda behippucha min da.

Amar ribbi chizkiyya, hachi hu vadday, zakkaa ihu, man dechulakeh itkeyyaym besitra tava, vela yarchin garmeh lesitra ochora, veyishteziv minhon. amar leh ribbi yehuda, hachi hu vadday, vezakkaa man deyachil leishtezava minneh mehahu sitra, vezakkain inun tzaddikayya, deyachle leishtezava minnayyhu, velaagacha kerava behahu sitra. amar ribbi chizkiyya bemma. patach veamar, (Mishlei 24:6) ki betachbulot taase lecha milchama vegomer. man milchama, da milchama dehahu sitra bisha, deitzterich bar nash laagacha beh kerava, uleshaltaa aloy uleishtezava minneh.

Ta chaze, deyaakov hachi ishtaddal legabbe esav, begin hahu sitra dileh. leitchakkema aloy ulemezal immeh beakimu bechol ma deitzterich, begin leshaltaa aloy beresha vesofa, vecholla kedka yeut. veresha vesofa kechada da kegavvna da, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 25) bechorati, ulevatar birchati, sheruta vesofa kechada, da kegavvna da. begin leshalletaa aloy beorach meshar kedka chaze leh. uvegin kach zakkaa ihu man deishteziv minnayyhu, veyachil leshalletaa alayyhu.

Ta chaze, zechira ufekida letav inun kechada beraza dimhemnuta, vezakkaa ihu man deishtaddal batar mehemnuta, kema deat amer, (Hoshea 11:10) achare Adonai yelchu kearye yishag vegomer. amar ribbi chizkiyya hachi hu vadday.
Veta chaze, bar nash kad tzalle tzeloteh, la yema aleh zachreni ufakdeni. begin deikka zechira ufekida letav, uzechira ufekida
319: Levish, vezamminin lenatla milla min puma, veatyayn leadkara chovoy devar nash velaanasha leh. bar i ihu zakkaa shelim, dechad badke chovoy, hahi zechira ufekida levish la yishkechun lon, kegon ezra deamar (Nechemya 13:31) zachra li elohay letova.

Deha bechol atar, devar nash tzalle tzeloteh, yachlil garmeh ben saggiin bichlala desaggiin. veta chaze shunammit, kad amar lah elisha, (Melachim 2 4:13) hayesh ledabber lach el hammelech o el sar hatztzava. hayesh ledabber lach el hammelech, hahu yoma, yom tov derosh hashshana hava, vehahu yoma demalchuta dirkia shalta lemedan alma, vekudesha berich hu ikre melech hammishpat behahu zimna. uvegin kach amar lah, hayesh ledabber lach el hammelech.

Ma ketiv, (Melachim 2 4:13) vattomer betoch ammi anochi yoshevet. may kaamra. la vaena, lemeheve reshimaa leela, ella leaalaa reshay ben saggiin, vela leafaka mikkelala dilhon. vechach bae leh levar nash, leitkelala bichlala desaggiin vela leityaychada bilchodoy, begin dela yishgechun aleh, leadkara chovoy kidkaamaran.

Patach ribbi yehuda veamar (Iyov 38:17) haniglu lecha shaare mavet veshaare tzalmavet tire. hay kera, kudesha berich hu amar leh leiyyov, kad chama deiyyov dachik garmeh al dinoy dekudesha berich hu. ta chaze, iyyov amar (Iyov 13:15) hen yikteleni lo ayachel, ketiv lo beAlef vekare lo beVav, vecholla ihu.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu, vechi ana katil bene nasha, haniglu lecha shaare mavt veshaare tzalmavet tire, kamma tarin inun petichan behahu sitra. umota shalta alayyhu, vechullehu setimin mibbene nasha, (sefer acher velo yachlin leistammera minnayyhu begin deinnun setimin mibbene nasha) vela yadin inun shearim.

Veshaare tzalmavet tire. man inun shaare mavet vman inun shaare tzalmavet. ella mavet vetzalmavet kechada inun, veziuuga chada inun. mavet ha ittemar, da malach hammavt, veha ukemuha. tzalmavet, tzel mavet. hay ihu man derachiv aleh, veihu tzilla dileh, vetukefa dileh, leizdavvevga kechada, bekishshura chad veinun chad.

Vechol inun dargin denafke minnayyhu umitkashsheran behu inun shearim dilhon kema dilela, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 24:7) seu shearim rashechem vegomer. veillen (inun seorim) ikkeru naharin venachalin, shit sitrin dealma. uf hachi inun shaare mavet, veshaare tzalmavet missitra ochora, dargin yedian deshaltin bealma. shaare mavt veshaare tzalmavet, da nukeva veda dechura, vetarvavyyhu kechada.

Veal da, amar kudesha berich hu le leiyyov, begin kol inun millin, deihu amar (Iyov 7:9) kala anan vayyelach ken yored sheol lo yaale, vechol inun shear millin. amar kudesha berich hu haniglu lecha shaare mavet, leminda deha kullehu birshuti, vechullehu zeminin leitbaara mealma, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) billa hammavt lanetzach vegomer.

Ta chaze, (Bereshit 30:22-23) vayyizkor elohim et rachel vayyishma eleha elohim vayiftach et rachamah. tere zimnin, elohim elohim, ammay. ella, chad mealma didchura, vechad mealma denukeva, begin divmazzala talyay milleta.

Vechad itarat rachel bishma da, dichtiv, (Bereshit 30:24) yosef Adonai li ben acher, yada yaakov deihi itchazzeyay leashlama kullehu shivtin vela titkayyem bealma, begin kach baa lemezal vela yachil. vechad mata zimna devinyamin, arak veazal leh, begin devara ochora la yishtelam beta, leitkashshera alma kaddisha beh.

Vehayeynu dichtiv, (Bereshit 31:3) vayyomer Adonai el yaakov shuv el eretz avotecha ulemoladtecha veehye immach. may veehye immach. ella amar leh, ad hacha, rachel havat immach ikkera deveta. mikkan ulehala, ana ehe immach veetol beta bahadach bitresar shivtin. vehayeynu dichtiv, vaani bevoi mippaddan meta alay rachel. alay hava, uvegini hava milla deitdachya ihi veatya diyyura ochora, venatla veta begini ledayyra immi.
(Bereshit 30:28) vayyomer nakva secharcha alay veettena, may nakva. amar ribbi yitzchak, hahu rasha amar, ana chame, deyaakov la istakkel ella benukeve,
